a.zh: 不一定。Turpin 等人的实验表明，模型的答案可以被输入中的某个线索左右，而它写出的解释完全不提这个线索，在 13 个任务上这类线索使正确率最多下降 36 个百分点。写出的推理是模型生成的又一段文本，它与内部实际的计算之间是否一致，需要另外检验。常用的办法是对输入或内部状态做干预，观察答案是否随之改变，这是阶段 9 的内容。
a.en: Not necessarily. The experiments of Turpin and colleagues show that the answer of a model can be swayed by a cue in the input while its written explanation does not mention the cue at all, and such cues lowered accuracy by up to 36 percentage points across 13 tasks. Written reasoning is one more text generated by the model, and whether it agrees with the actual internal computation has to be tested separately. The usual approach is to intervene on the input or on internal states and observe whether the answer changes with it, which is the content of stage 9.

q.zh: 写提示词应当从哪里入手？
q.en: Where should one start when writing prompts?

a.zh: 先确定怎样判断好坏，再改提示词。Anthropic 的提示工程文档把三样东西列为前提，即明确的成功标准、能够按这些标准做检验的评测，以及一份待改进的初稿。在此基础上，常用的手段包括把任务和要求写清楚、给出示例、让模型先推理、用标签把提示词的各部分分开。该文档也指出，并非所有问题都适合靠改提示词解决，延迟和成本这类问题换一个模型往往更直接。
a.en: First settle how good and bad are judged, then change the prompt. The prompt engineering documentation of Anthropic lists three prerequisites, namely clear success criteria, evaluations that can test against them, and a first draft to improve. On that basis the usual means include stating the task and requirements clearly, giving examples, letting the model reason first and separating the parts of a prompt with tags. The same documentation notes that not every problem is best solved by changing the prompt, and that issues such as latency and cost are often addressed more directly by another model.

plain.zh: 少样本提示像给新同事看几份填好的样表，他不需要培训，照着样子就知道该怎么填，脑子里的知识并没有变。思维链像做题时打草稿。三步的题心算容易出错，把中间结果写在纸上，后面每一步都可以回头看，自然更准。但草稿上写的未必是真实的思路，有时是先有了答案，再补上理由。
plain.en: Few-shot prompting is like showing a new colleague a few completed forms. No training is needed, the pattern shows how to fill them in, and the knowledge in their head has not changed. Chain of thought is like working on scratch paper. A problem of three steps easily goes wrong in the head, and with intermediate results on paper every later step can look back at them and is more accurate. What stands on the scratch paper is not necessarily the real line of thought, though. Sometimes the answer came first and the reasons were added afterwards.

summary.zh: 先检索再生成。手写关键词检索和向量检索，融合与重排，并在一个虚构小镇的资料上搭建完整的问答流程。
summary.en: Retrieve first, then generate. Keyword and vector retrieval by hand, fusion and reranking, and a complete question-answering pipeline over material about an invented town.

why.zh: 模型的知识停留在训练数据截止的时刻，也不包含任何非公开的资料，对于没有见过的事实，它仍然会给出流畅的回答。检索增强生成的做法是在回答之前先从外部资料中找出相关的段落，放进提示词，让模型依据这些段落作答。这样可以使用最新的或私有的资料，回答也可以追溯到出处。它是目前把大模型接入实际业务时使用最广的方式。它同时提供了一个观察模型怎样使用上下文证据的场合，检索到了正确的段落而答案仍然出错的情形，正是本路线后面要分析的问题。
why.en: The knowledge of a model stops at the cutoff of its training data and includes no non-public material, yet for facts it has never seen it still produces fluent answers. Retrieval-augmented generation first finds relevant passages in external material, places them in the prompt and has the model answer from these passages. Current or private material can be used this way, and answers can be traced to their sources. It is at present the most widely used way of connecting large models to practical applications. It also offers a setting for observing how a model uses evidence in its context. The case in which the right passage was retrieved and the answer is still wrong is exactly what this roadmap analyses later.

goals.zh: 能实现 BM25 和基于嵌入的检索，并说明两者各自擅长的查询
goals.en: Implement BM25 and embedding-based retrieval and say which queries each is good at

goals.zh: 能用 RRF 融合两路结果，并用 Recall@k 和 MRR 评价检索
goals.en: Fuse two result lists with RRF and evaluate retrieval with Recall@k and MRR

goals.zh: 能搭建检索、重排、生成的完整流程，并把检索错误与生成错误分开分析
goals.en: Build the full pipeline of retrieval, reranking and generation and analyse retrieval errors and generation errors separately

explain.zh: **整体流程。** RAG 分为离线和在线两部分。离线时把资料切成段落，为每个段落建立索引。在线时对用户的问题做检索，取出最相关的几个段落，与问题一起拼成提示词，再交给模型生成回答。Lewis 等人在提出这一方法的论文中把两类记忆做了区分。模型权重中的知识称为参数化记忆，可检索的外部资料称为非参数化记忆，后者可以随时更新，也能指明出处。
explain.en: **The overall flow.** RAG has an offline and an online part. Offline, the material is cut into passages and an index is built for every passage. Online, the question of the user is used for retrieval, the few most relevant passages are taken, combined with the question into a prompt and handed to the model for generation. In the paper that proposed the method, Lewis and colleagues distinguish two kinds of memory. Knowledge in the model weights is called parametric memory and retrievable external material non-parametric memory, the latter being updatable at any time and able to indicate its source.

explain.zh: **关键词检索。** BM25 是经典的关键词排序方法。它对问题中的每个词计算一个分数再相加，这个分数由三个因素决定。词在全部段落中越少见，权重越高。词在某个段落中出现的次数越多，分数越高，但增长会饱和。段落越长，分数相应打折。它只认字面上相同的词，对编号、专有名词这类必须精确匹配的内容很有效，对换了说法的问题则无能为力。
explain.en: **Keyword retrieval.** BM25 is the classic keyword ranking method. It computes a score for every word of the question and adds them up, and three factors determine this score. The rarer a word across all passages, the higher its weight. The more often a word occurs in a passage, the higher the score, with saturating growth. The longer a passage, the more the score is discounted. It recognizes only literally identical words, works very well for content that must match exactly, such as codes and proper names, and can do nothing for questions phrased differently.

explain.zh: **向量检索。** 用一个嵌入模型把每个段落编码成一个向量，问题也编码成向量，按向量之间的余弦相似度排序。含义相近而用词不同的文本，向量也会接近，所以它能处理换了说法的问题。段落的向量可以预先算好，查询时只需要编码问题并做一次矩阵乘法。段落数量很大时，逐个比较会很慢，FAISS 这类库提供了牺牲少量精度换取速度的近似搜索。
explain.en: **Vector retrieval.** An embedding model encodes every passage as a vector, the question is encoded as a vector too, and passages are ranked by the cosine similarity between the vectors. Texts close in meaning and different in wording have nearby vectors, so questions phrased differently can be handled. The passage vectors can be computed in advance, and a query needs only the encoding of the question and one matrix multiplication. With very many passages, comparing one by one becomes slow, and libraries such as FAISS provide approximate search that trades a little precision for speed.

explain.zh: **两者的互补与融合。** 练习 1 至练习 3 使用 30 个关于一个虚构小镇的段落和 20 个问题，其中 12 个问题沿用了原文的用词或编号，8 个是换了说法的。BM25 在前一类上的 MRR 是 0.96，在后一类上只有 0.33。向量检索在后一类上是 1.00，在前一类上是 0.92，出错的是 LH-204 和 LH-207 这类只差几个字符的编号。倒数排名融合（RRF）只使用排名不使用分数，把一个段落在各路结果中的排名的倒数相加。在这份数据上，等权重的 RRF 总体 MRR 为 0.81，低于单独使用向量检索的 0.95，原因是 BM25 在换了说法的问题上把正确段落排得很靠后，拖累了融合后的结果。这个结果与常见的说法不完全一致。Anthropic 在其检索实验中报告嵌入加 BM25 优于单独使用嵌入。可见融合是否有益取决于数据和两路检索各自的质量，需要在自己的数据上测量。
explain.en: **Complementarity and fusion.** Exercises 1 to 3 use 30 passages about an invented town and 20 questions, of which 12 reuse the wording or an identifier of the passage and 8 are paraphrases. BM25 reaches an MRR of 0.96 on the first kind and only 0.33 on the second. Vector retrieval reaches 1.00 on the second kind and 0.92 on the first, where it errs on identifiers that differ in a few characters, such as LH-204 and LH-207. Reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) uses only ranks and no scores, adding up the reciprocals of the ranks a passage has in the individual result lists. On these data equal-weight RRF has an overall MRR of 0.81, below the 0.95 of vector retrieval alone, because BM25 places the right passage very low for paraphrased questions and drags the fused result down. This is not fully in line with the common account. Anthropic reports in its retrieval experiments that embeddings plus BM25 are better than embeddings alone. Whether fusion helps thus depends on the data and on the quality of each of the two retrievers, and has to be measured on one's own data.

explain.zh: **重排。** 嵌入模型分别编码问题和段落，两者之间没有交互，这种结构叫双编码器。交叉编码器把问题和段落拼在一起输入，直接输出一个相关性分数，判断更准确，但每个候选段落都要做一次前向计算，无法预先算好。通常的做法是先用便宜的方法召回几十个候选，再用交叉编码器对它们重新排序。练习 3 中，对前 8 个候选重排后，向量检索的首位命中率从 0.90 升到 0.95，RRF 的从 0.75 升到 0.90。
explain.en: **Reranking.** An embedding model encodes question and passage separately with no interaction between them, a structure called a bi-encoder. A cross-encoder takes question and passage together as input and outputs a relevance score directly. Its judgement is more accurate, but every candidate passage needs its own forward pass and nothing can be computed in advance. The usual practice is to recall a few dozen candidates with a cheap method and then reorder them with a cross-encoder. In exercise 3, reranking the first 8 candidates raises the top-1 hit rate of vector retrieval from 0.90 to 0.95 and that of RRF from 0.75 to 0.90.

explain.zh: **完整流程的结果。** 练习 4 把检索、融合、重排和一个 5 亿参数的生成模型连接起来。资料描述的是虚构的地方，模型不可能在训练中见过。不使用检索时，20 个问题只答对 2 个，并且回答的语气同样肯定，例如把一座容量为 3800 人的体育场说成约 100 万人。使用检索后答对 16 个。当提供的段落不含答案时，模型按提示词的要求回答了不知道。
explain.en: **The result of the full pipeline.** Exercise 4 connects retrieval, fusion, reranking and a generation model of 0.5 billion parameters. The material describes invented places that the model cannot have seen in training. Without retrieval, 2 of 20 questions are answered correctly, in an equally confident tone, for example by giving a stadium with a capacity of 3,800 a capacity of about one million. With retrieval, 16 are answered correctly. When the supplied passages do not contain the answer, the model says it does not know, as the prompt asks.

explain.zh: **检索对了仍然答错。** 在 20 个问题中，有 19 个问题的正确段落进入了前 3 名，其中 3 个仍然答错。一个问题问样本保存的温度，模型把同一句话里的样本数量 14300 当成了温度的来源，回答 14 度。一个问题问表格 S-17 的用途，模型采用了同时被检索到的另一个表格 S-12 的描述。一个问题问集市在星期几，模型把星期三和星期六答成了星期六和星期日。这三个错误都发生在生成阶段，说明把证据放进上下文并不保证模型正确地使用它。评测时应当把检索是否命中与回答是否正确分开统计，才能知道问题出在哪一步。
explain.en: **Right retrieval, wrong answer.** For 19 of the 20 questions the right passage is among the top 3, and 3 of these are still answered wrongly. One question asks at what temperature samples are stored, and the model takes the number of samples in the same sentence, 14,300, as the source of the temperature and answers 14 degrees. One asks what form S-17 is for, and the model adopts the description of another form, S-12, that was retrieved alongside. One asks on which days the market is held, and the model turns Wednesdays and Saturdays into Saturdays and Sundays. All three errors occur in the generation stage and show that putting evidence into the context does not guarantee that the model uses it correctly. Evaluation should count separately whether retrieval hit and whether the answer is right, so that it is known at which step a problem arises.

caption.zh: 练习 1 至练习 4 搭建的流程。两路检索的结果经 RRF 融合，再由交叉编码器重排，取前 3 个段落放入提示词。
caption.en: The pipeline built in exercises 1 to 4. The results of two retrievers are fused by RRF and reranked by a cross-encoder, and the top 3 passages go into the prompt.

source.text: Practical BM25, Part 2: The BM25 Algorithm and its Variables (Elastic)

steps.tex: \text{score}(q, d) = \sum_{t \in q} \text{idf}(t) \cdot \frac{f(t, d)\, (k_1 + 1)}{f(t, d) + k_1 \left( 1 - b + b\, \frac{|d|}{\text{avgdl}} \right)}

note.zh: $f(t, d)$ 是词 $t$ 在段落 $d$ 中出现的次数，$|d|$ 是段落的长度，avgdl 是平均长度。$k_1$ 和 $b$ 是两个可调的参数，练习中取 1.5 和 0.75。
note.en: $f(t, d)$ is how often the word $t$ occurs in passage $d$, $|d|$ the length of the passage and avgdl the average length. $k_1$ and $b$ are two tunable parameters, set to 1.5 and 0.75 in the exercises.

note.zh: $N$ 是段落总数，$n_t$ 是包含词 $t$ 的段落数。越少见的词权重越高。像 the 这样几乎每个段落都有的词，权重接近 0。
note.en: $N$ is the number of passages and $n_t$ the number containing the word $t$. Rarer words weigh more. A word such as the, present in nearly every passage, has a weight close to 0.

note.zh: 词频的饱和。一个词出现 10 次带来的分数远不到出现 1 次的 10 倍，分数有上限。$k_1$ 越小，饱和得越快。
note.en: Saturation of term frequency. A word occurring 10 times brings far less than 10 times the score of one occurrence, and the score has an upper bound. The smaller $k_1$, the faster the saturation.

steps.tex: b = 0:\ \text{no length normalization} \qquad\qquad b = 1:\ \text{full normalization by } |d| / \text{avgdl}

note.zh: 长度归一化。较长的段落更容易碰巧包含查询词，所以要打折，$b$ 控制打折的力度。
note.en: Length normalization. Longer passages are more likely to contain query words by chance and are therefore discounted, with $b$ controlling how strongly.

title.zh: 向量检索与两种编码器的代价
title.en: Vector retrieval and the cost of the two encoders

source.text: Reimers & Gurevych, Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks, arXiv:1908.10084

steps.tex: e(x) = \frac{\bar h(x)}{\lVert \bar h(x) \rVert},\qquad \bar h(x) = \frac{\sum_i m_i\, h_i}{\sum_i m_i}

note.zh: 均值池化。把编码器最后一层各个位置的向量取平均，$m_i$ 是注意力掩码，使填充位置不计入，再归一化为单位长度。
note.en: Mean pooling. The vectors of all positions in the last encoder layer are averaged, with the attention mask $m_i$ excluding padding positions, and then normalized to unit length.

note.zh: 单位向量的点积就是余弦相似度。所有段落的向量排成一个矩阵，一次矩阵乘法就得到问题与全部段落的相似度。
note.en: The dot product of unit vectors is the cosine similarity. With all passage vectors stacked in a matrix, one matrix multiplication gives the similarity of the question to every passage.

steps.tex: \text{bi-encoder: } 1 \text{ forward pass per query} \qquad\qquad \text{cross-encoder: } N \text{ forward passes per query}

note.zh: 双编码器的段落向量可以预先计算，查询时只编码问题。交叉编码器必须把问题与每个段落配对输入。Reimers 和 Gurevych 给出的例子是，在 1 万个句子中找出最相似的一对，交叉编码方式需要约 5000 万次计算、约 65 小时，改用句向量后约 5 秒。这就是先召回再重排的理由。
note.en: The passage vectors of a bi-encoder can be precomputed and a query encodes only the question. A cross-encoder has to take the question paired with every passage as input. In the example of Reimers and Gurevych, finding the most similar pair among 10,000 sentences takes about 50 million computations and about 65 hours by cross-encoding, and about 5 seconds with sentence vectors. This is the reason for recalling first and reranking afterwards.

source.text: Cormack, Clarke, Büttcher, Reciprocal Rank Fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual Rank Learning Methods, SIGIR 2009

note.zh: $R$ 是若干个排序结果，$r(d)$ 是段落 $d$ 在其中一个结果里的名次。只用名次不用分数，所以 BM25 分数和余弦相似度这样量纲不同的结果可以直接合并。$k$ 用来减弱最前面几名的优势，原论文取 60。
note.en: $R$ is a set of rankings and $r(d)$ the rank of passage $d$ in one of them. Only ranks and no scores are used, so results on different scales, such as BM25 scores and cosine similarities, can be merged directly. $k$ dampens the advantage of the very first ranks, and the original paper uses 60.

note.zh: 每个问题只有一个正确段落时的定义，即正确段落进入前 $k$ 名的问题所占的比例。它回答的是放进提示词的 $k$ 个段落里有没有答案。
note.en: The definition when each question has one correct passage, that is, the share of questions whose correct passage is within the first $k$. It answers whether the $k$ passages placed in the prompt contain the answer.

note.zh: 平均倒数排名。正确段落排第 1 得 1 分，排第 2 得 0.5 分，排第 10 得 0.1 分。它比 Recall@k 更关注正确段落是否排在最前面。
note.en: Mean reciprocal rank. A correct passage at rank 1 scores 1, at rank 2 scores 0.5 and at rank 10 scores 0.1. It attends more than Recall@k to whether the correct passage is at the very top.

q.zh: 为什么 RAG 检索到了正确文档，答案仍然可能出错？
q.en: Why can RAG answer wrongly even after retrieving the right document?

a.zh: 检索和生成是两个独立的环节，证据进入上下文之后，模型还要正确地读取和使用它。练习 4 中出现了三种情况。模型从正确的段落里取错了数字。模型采用了同时被检索到的另一个相似段落。模型在复述时改动了内容。除此之外还有两类已知的原因。证据位于长上下文的中部时更容易被忽略，见 3.2。证据与模型已有的知识冲突时，模型不一定采用证据，反过来它也可能轻信错误的证据。Wu 等人的测试发现，多个大模型在超过 60% 的情况下会采用检索到的错误内容并放弃自己原本正确的回答，检索内容偏离事实越远，被采用的可能性越低。
a.en: Retrieval and generation are two separate stages, and once evidence is in the context the model still has to read and use it correctly. Three cases appear in exercise 4. The model takes the wrong number from the right passage. The model adopts another, similar passage that was retrieved alongside. The model alters the content while restating it. Two further kinds of causes are known. Evidence in the middle of a long context is more easily ignored, see 3.2. When evidence conflicts with what the model already knows, the model does not necessarily adopt the evidence, and conversely it may trust wrong evidence too readily. The tests of Wu and colleagues found that several large models adopted incorrect retrieved content and gave up their own originally correct answer in over 60% of cases, and that retrieved content is less likely to be adopted the further it departs from the truth.

q.zh: 混合检索是否总是比单一检索好？
q.en: Is hybrid retrieval always better than a single retriever?

a.zh: 不是。在本模块的数据上，等权重的 RRF 比单独使用向量检索差，因为其中一路在一部分问题上很弱。在编号、型号、专有名词较多的资料上，关键词检索的贡献会明显得多，Anthropic 报告的实验就属于这种情况。常见的改进包括给两路结果不同的权重、只在向量检索置信度较低时引入关键词结果，以及在融合之后加上重排。练习 3 中重排把 RRF 的首位命中率从 0.75 提高到了 0.90。选择哪种方案应当以自己数据上的评测结果为准。
a.en: No. On the data of this module equal-weight RRF is worse than vector retrieval alone, because one of the two retrievers is very weak on part of the questions. On material with many codes, model numbers and proper names the contribution of keyword retrieval is far more visible, which is the situation of the experiments reported by Anthropic. Common improvements include different weights for the two lists, bringing in keyword results only when vector retrieval is less confident, and reranking after fusion. In exercise 3 reranking raises the top-1 hit rate of RRF from 0.75 to 0.90. Which scheme to choose should follow the evaluation on one's own data.

q.zh: 向量检索为什么会在编号上出错？
q.en: Why does vector retrieval err on identifiers?

a.zh: 嵌入模型学到的是语义上的相近。LH-204 与 LH-207 所在的两个句子结构相同、主题相同，只有几个字符不同，它们的向量非常接近。问题中的编号在向量里只占很小的分量，不足以把两者分开。关键词检索把 LH-204 当作一个完整的词，只有完全相同才算匹配，在这类查询上更可靠。
a.en: An embedding model learns closeness in meaning. The two sentences containing LH-204 and LH-207 share structure and topic and differ in a few characters, so their vectors are very close. The identifier in the question accounts for only a small component of the vector, not enough to separate the two. Keyword retrieval treats LH-204 as one whole word that matches only when identical, and is more reliable on such queries.

q.zh: RAG、微调和长上下文应当怎样选？
q.en: How should one choose between RAG, fine-tuning and a long context?

a.zh: 三者解决的问题不同。RAG 适合需要引用具体事实、资料经常更新或者需要注明出处的场合，知识保存在模型之外。微调适合改变模型的行为方式，例如输出的格式和语气、某类任务的做法，对于灌输大量具体事实则效率不高，还有遗忘的风险，见 4.2 和 4.5。资料总量不大时，可以把全部内容直接放进上下文，省去检索这一步，代价是每次请求的成本和延迟更高，并且长上下文中部的信息利用得较差。实际系统经常组合使用。
a.en: The three solve different problems. RAG suits cases that need specific facts cited, material that changes often or sources to be indicated, with the knowledge kept outside the model. Fine-tuning suits changing how a model behaves, such as the format and tone of output or the way of handling a kind of task. It is inefficient for instilling many specific facts and carries the risk of forgetting, see 4.2 and 4.5. When the material is small in total, everything can be placed directly in the context and retrieval skipped, at the price of higher cost and latency per request and poorer use of information in the middle of a long context. Practical systems often combine them.

q.zh: 怎样评价一个 RAG 系统？
q.en: How is a RAG system evaluated?

a.zh: 分两层。检索层用 Recall@k 和 MRR 这类指标，衡量正确的段落是否被找到、排在第几。生成层衡量回答是否正确以及是否忠实于所给的段落。两层需要分开统计，否则无法判断应当改进哪一部分。练习 4 用的是最简单的判断方法，即检查回答中是否包含正确答案的关键字符串。这种方法偏宽松，回答中夹带了错误内容时仍会被算作正确。更可靠的评测方法在阶段 8 讨论。
a.en: On two levels. The retrieval level uses metrics such as Recall@k and MRR to measure whether the right passage is found and at which rank. The generation level measures whether the answer is right and whether it is faithful to the passages given. The two levels have to be counted separately, or it cannot be judged which part needs improving. Exercise 4 uses the simplest check, whether the reply contains the key string of the correct answer. This check is lenient and still counts a reply as correct when it carries wrong content alongside. More reliable evaluation methods are discussed in stage 8.

plain.zh: 闭卷考试只能凭记忆，记不清的地方容易瞎编。RAG 相当于改成开卷，先到书架上把相关的几页找出来，再对着这几页作答。关键词检索像按书后的索引查，词必须对得上。向量检索像请教一位熟悉内容的图书管理员，换一种说法他也知道要的是哪一本。开卷同样可能答错，例如翻对了页却抄错了行。
plain.en: A closed-book exam relies on memory, and where memory is vague things get made up. RAG turns it into an open-book exam, in which the relevant pages are first fetched from the shelf and the answer is written with them at hand. Keyword retrieval is like using the index at the back of a book, where the word has to match. Vector retrieval is like asking a librarian who knows the contents and understands which book is meant even when it is described differently. An open-book answer can still be wrong, for instance when the right page is found and the wrong line copied.

summary.zh: 模型怎样“调用”工具，一个智能体循环由哪几部分组成，以及系统提示词为什么不能当作安全边界。
summary.en: How a model calls tools, what an agent loop consists of, and why a system prompt cannot serve as a security boundary.

why.zh: 模型本身只能生成文本，不能查询数据库、运行代码或访问网络。工具调用让模型把想要执行的操作写成一段结构化的文本，由外围的程序去执行，再把结果交还给模型。把这个过程循环起来，模型就能分多步完成任务，这样的系统称为智能体。它是目前大模型应用中发展最快的方向，也是本路线研究背景的直接来源，分析模型是否忠实地使用了工具返回的证据，前提是清楚工具结果是以什么形式进入模型的。本模块不使用任何框架，从头写出这个循环，以便看清其中每一步都只是文本的拼接与生成。
why.en: A model by itself can only generate text and cannot query a database, run code or access the network. Tool calling lets the model write the operation it wants performed as a piece of structured text, which the surrounding program executes before handing the result back to the model. Looping this process lets the model complete tasks in several steps, and such a system is called an agent. It is at present the fastest-moving direction among applications of large models and the direct source of the research background of this roadmap. Analysing whether a model uses the evidence returned by tools faithfully presupposes knowing in what form tool results enter the model. This module uses no framework and writes the loop from scratch, so that every step can be seen to be nothing more than assembling and generating text.

goals.zh: 能说明一次工具调用中模型与外围程序各自做了什么
goals.en: State what the model and the surrounding program each do in one tool call

goals.zh: 能不依赖框架写出带错误处理和步数上限的智能体循环
goals.en: Write an agent loop with error handling and a step limit without a framework

goals.zh: 能从机制上解释系统提示词和工具结果中的指令为什么可能被错误地对待
goals.en: Explain mechanistically why instructions in a system prompt and in tool results may be treated wrongly

explain.zh: **模型并没有调用函数。** 一次工具调用分为四步。程序把每个工具的名称、用途和参数写成 JSON 模式，由对话模板拼进提示词。模型读到这些描述后，如果判断需要某个工具，就输出一段约定格式的文本，写明工具名和参数。程序解析这段文本，检查参数，真正去执行对应的函数。执行结果作为一条新的消息追加到对话中，模型据此继续生成。练习 2 打印了对话模板渲染后的提示词，可以看到工具的描述就是系统部分里的一段普通文本，模型的“调用”就是一段带有特定标签的 JSON。
explain.en: **The model does not call a function.** A tool call has four steps. The program writes the name, purpose and parameters of every tool as a JSON schema, which the chat template inserts into the prompt. Having read these descriptions, the model, if it judges that a tool is needed, outputs a piece of text in an agreed format that states the tool name and arguments. The program parses this text, checks the arguments and actually executes the corresponding function. The result is appended to the conversation as a new message, from which the model continues generating. Exercise 2 prints the prompt as rendered by the chat template, where the tool descriptions are an ordinary piece of text in the system part and the call of the model is a piece of JSON within particular tags.

explain.zh: **工具的作用。** 练习 2 中，同一个 5 亿参数的模型在没有工具时把 37 乘以 46 算成 1802，提供乘法工具后，它输出了参数正确的调用，最终回答 1702。工具把模型不擅长的事情交给了确定性的程序。模型需要做的是判断何时使用哪个工具、填写什么参数，以及怎样把结果组织成回答。
explain.en: **What tools are for.** In exercise 2 the same model of 0.5 billion parameters computes 37 times 46 as 1802 without tools. Given a multiplication tool, it outputs a call with the right arguments and finally answers 1702. Tools hand what a model is poor at to deterministic programs. What remains for the model is to judge when to use which tool, which arguments to fill in and how to arrange the result into an answer.

explain.zh: **循环。** 把上述过程重复执行，就是智能体的核心。每一轮让模型生成一次。如果输出中没有工具调用，就把它当作最终回答并结束。如果有，就执行工具，把调用和结果都追加到对话里，进入下一轮。Anthropic 对此的概括是，智能体通常只是在循环中根据环境反馈使用工具的大模型。该文还区分了两类系统，流程由预先写好的代码决定的称为工作流，由模型自己决定下一步做什么的称为智能体。
explain.en: **The loop.** Repeating the process above is the core of an agent. In every round the model generates once. If the output contains no tool call, it is taken as the final answer and the loop ends. If it does, the tools are executed, both the call and the result are appended to the conversation, and the next round begins. Anthropic sums this up by saying that agents are typically just large models using tools based on environmental feedback in a loop. The same article distinguishes two kinds of systems. Those whose flow is determined by code written in advance are called workflows, and those in which the model itself decides what to do next are called agents.

explain.zh: **循环里必须处理的三件事。** 练习 3 用一个按剧本回答的替身代替模型，逐项检查了这三件事。模型可能请求不存在的工具、漏掉参数，或者输出无法解析的 JSON。这些情况不应当让程序崩溃，应当把错误信息作为工具结果返回，让模型看到并自行调整。模型可能一直请求工具而不给出回答，所以要设定步数上限。每一轮的调用和结果都要原样保留在对话中，因为模型没有其他记忆，它对任务进展的全部了解都来自上下文。
explain.en: **Three things a loop has to handle.** Exercise 3 replaces the model by a stand-in that answers from a script and checks these three things one by one. The model may request a tool that does not exist, omit an argument or output JSON that cannot be parsed. Such cases should not crash the program. The error message should be returned as the tool result for the model to see and adjust to. The model may keep requesting tools without giving an answer, so a step limit is set. The calls and results of every round have to stay in the conversation unchanged, since the model has no other memory and everything it knows about the progress of the task comes from the context.

explain.zh: **框架做了什么。** 练习 4 用 LangChain 的 `@tool` 定义了同样的两个工具。它生成的 JSON 模式与练习 1 手写的注册表在工具名、参数类型和必填项上完全一致，把它接到练习 3 的循环上，运行结果也相同。框架提供的是这些部件的现成实现以及与各种服务的对接，机制并没有不同。Anthropic 的建议是先直接使用模型的 API，如果使用框架，要确保理解它底层的代码，因为抽象层会遮住实际发送的提示词和收到的回复，增加排查问题的难度。各种框架的比较不在本路线的范围之内，可以参看姊妹项目 Agent Atlas。
explain.en: **What a framework does.** Exercise 4 defines the same two tools with `@tool` of LangChain. The JSON schema it generates agrees fully with the hand-written registry of exercise 1 in tool names, parameter types and required parameters, and connected to the loop of exercise 3 it produces the same run. A framework provides ready-made implementations of these parts and connections to various services, and the mechanism is no different. Anthropic advises starting with the API of the model directly and, where a framework is used, making sure the code beneath it is understood, since layers of abstraction hide the prompts actually sent and the replies received and make debugging harder. A comparison of frameworks lies outside this roadmap and can be found in the sibling project Agent Atlas.

explain.zh: **指令与数据没有分界。** 系统提示词、用户消息、工具返回的内容，在进入模型之前都被拼成同一个 token 序列。角色标记也只是序列里的几个特殊 token。模型的结构中没有任何部件规定某一段文本的优先级更高，或者某一段文本只能当作数据。模型之所以通常遵从系统提示词，是训练使它倾向于这样做，这是一种统计上的倾向，不是一条被强制执行的规则。练习 3 的最后做了两个观察。系统提示词要求不得透露一个门禁码，三种询问方式下这个 5 亿参数的模型都把它说了出来，包括最直接的那一种。另一个观察中，工具返回的网页文本里夹带了一句“忽略此前的全部指令”，模型这一次没有照做，仍然回答了开放时间。单次测试不能说明它不会被别的写法影响。
explain.en: **No boundary between instructions and data.** The system prompt, user messages and content returned by tools are all assembled into one token sequence before entering the model. Role markers too are merely a few special tokens in the sequence. No component in the architecture of the model provides that one stretch of text has higher priority or that another may only be treated as data. That a model usually follows its system prompt is something training has inclined it to do, a statistical tendency and not an enforced rule. Exercise 3 ends with two observations. The system prompt demands that a door code not be revealed, and this model of 0.5 billion parameters states it under all three ways of asking, including the most direct one. In the other observation the web page text returned by a tool carries the sentence to ignore all previous instructions, and this time the model does not comply and still answers with the opening hours. A single test does not show that it would not be affected by another formulation.

caption.zh: 智能体循环。模型只负责生成文本，解析、校验和执行都由外围程序完成。每一轮的调用和结果都追加到对话中。
caption.en: The agent loop. The model only generates text, and parsing, validation and execution are all done by the surrounding program. The calls and results of every round are appended to the conversation.

title.en: A formal description of the loop

note.zh: $m_t$ 是第 $t$ 轮时的全部消息。对话模板把消息和工具描述渲染成一个字符串，模型生成回复 $a_t$。
note.en: $m_t$ is the list of all messages at round $t$. The chat template renders messages and tool descriptions into one string and the model generates the reply $a_t$.

note.zh: 回复中没有工具调用时，它就是最终回答。
note.en: A reply without a tool call is the final answer.

note.zh: 否则校验并执行调用，得到结果 $o_t$，把调用和结果都追加到消息列表。校验失败或执行出错时，$o_t$ 就是错误信息。
note.en: Otherwise the calls are validated and executed, giving the result $o_t$, and both call and result are appended to the message list. When validation fails or execution raises, $o_t$ is the error message.

note.zh: 达到步数上限时强制结束。这三行就是练习 3 中 `run_agent` 的全部逻辑。
note.en: The loop is forced to end at the step limit. These lines are the whole logic of `run_agent` in exercise 3.

title.zh: 多步任务的可靠性与成本
title.en: Reliability and cost of multi-step tasks

note.zh: 假设每一步独立地以概率 $p$ 正确，并且任何一步出错都使任务失败。这是一个偏悲观的简化，因为模型看到错误信息后有机会纠正。
note.en: Assume each step is correct independently with probability $p$ and any wrong step fails the task. This is a pessimistic simplification, since a model that sees an error message has a chance to correct itself.

note.zh: 单步看起来很高的正确率，在多步任务中会迅速下降。这是智能体需要校验、重试和人工确认环节的原因，也解释了为什么步数越多的任务对模型能力的要求越高。
note.en: A per-step accuracy that looks high falls quickly over a multi-step task. This is why agents need validation, retries and points of human confirmation, and it explains why tasks with more steps demand more of the model.

note.zh: 每一轮都要把此前的全部对话重新发送给模型。设初始提示词有 $c_0$ 个 token，每一轮增加 $\Delta$ 个，$n$ 轮累计的输入 token 数随 $n$ 的平方增长。5.2 中的提示词缓存正是针对这种不断重复的前缀。
note.en: Every round resends the whole conversation so far to the model. With an initial prompt of $c_0$ tokens growing by $\Delta$ per round, the input tokens accumulated over $n$ rounds grow with the square of $n$. The prompt caching of 5.2 addresses exactly this ever-repeated prefix.

note.zh: 一个数值例子。20 轮的任务累计输入 13.5 万个 token，其中 9.5 万来自不断增长的历史。
note.en: A numerical example. A task of 20 rounds accumulates 135 thousand input tokens, of which 95 thousand come from the growing history.

q.zh: 为什么 system prompt 会被绕过？
q.en: Why can a system prompt be bypassed?

a.zh: 因为从模型的角度看，系统提示词与用户输入、工具结果之间没有结构上的区别，它们都是同一个序列中的 token，注意力可以在其中任意两处之间建立联系。模型遵从系统提示词是训练形成的倾向，后面出现的文本如果足够有说服力，或者恰好落在训练没有覆盖到的写法上，这种倾向就可能被压过。Willison 在 2022 年把这类攻击命名为提示注入，并把它与 SQL 注入类比，两者的根源都是把指令和数据拼接在同一个字符串里。SQL 注入可以靠把代码与数据分开的参数化查询解决，他指出类似的分离在目前的语言模型结构上被证明极难实现。OWASP 的说明也写道，目前尚不清楚是否存在万无一失的防范方法。练习 3 中的小模型在最直接的询问下就泄露了内容。更大的模型在这类测试中稳健得多，但问题的性质相同。
a.en: Because from the point of view of the model there is no structural difference between the system prompt, user input and tool results. All are tokens in one sequence, and attention can relate any two places in it. Following the system prompt is a tendency formed by training, and later text that is persuasive enough, or that happens to fall on a formulation training did not cover, can override the tendency. In 2022 Willison named this kind of attack prompt injection and compared it to SQL injection, both rooted in concatenating instructions and data in one string. SQL injection can be solved by parameterized queries that keep code and data apart, and he notes that a similar separation has proven extremely difficult to implement on current language model architectures. The OWASP description likewise states that it is unclear whether fool-proof methods of prevention exist. The small model of exercise 3 leaks the content under the most direct question. Larger models are far more robust in such tests, but the nature of the problem is the same.

q.zh: 既然无法完全防住，实际系统怎样降低风险？
q.en: If it cannot be fully prevented, how do real systems reduce the risk?

a.zh: 思路是不把安全寄托在模型会听话上，而是限制模型出错时能造成的后果。OWASP 列出的措施包括限制模型可用的权限、对高风险操作要求人工确认、对输入和输出做过滤、把外部内容与指令分隔并标明来源、规定并校验输出格式，以及做对抗性测试。由此还可以得出一条简单的规则，不应当把密钥、口令这类不能泄露的内容放进提示词，凡是进入上下文的内容，都应当假定有可能被输出。
a.en: The idea is not to rest security on the model being obedient but to limit what an error of the model can cause. The measures listed by OWASP include restricting the privileges available to the model, requiring human approval for high-risk actions, filtering input and output, separating external content from instructions and marking its origin, defining and validating output formats, and adversarial testing. A simple rule also follows. Content that must not leak, such as keys and passwords, should not be placed in a prompt, and whatever enters the context should be assumed capable of being output.

q.zh: 什么是间接提示注入？
q.en: What is indirect prompt injection?

a.zh: 攻击者不直接与模型对话，而是把指令埋在模型将会读到的数据里，例如网页、邮件或文档。智能体通过工具取回这些内容时，其中的指令就进入了上下文。Greshake 等人指出，接入外部数据的应用模糊了数据与指令的界线，并演示了窃取会话数据、操纵应用调用其他接口等攻击。这对智能体尤其重要，因为它能执行操作，被注入之后的后果不限于输出一段错误的文字。
a.en: The attacker does not talk to the model directly but plants instructions in data the model is going to read, such as web pages, emails or documents. When an agent fetches such content through a tool, the instructions in it enter the context. Greshake and colleagues point out that applications connected to external data blur the line between data and instructions and demonstrate attacks such as stealing session data and manipulating the application into calling other interfaces. This matters especially for agents, which can perform actions, so the consequences of an injection are not limited to a wrong piece of output text.

q.zh: 工具调用为什么会出错？
q.en: Why do tool calls go wrong?

a.zh: 调用是模型生成的文本，5.3 中关于 JSON 的讨论同样适用。常见的问题有 JSON 格式不合法、参数缺失或类型不对、选择了不合适的工具，以及编造了并不存在的工具或参数值。Anthropic 的文档提醒，模型给出的输入并不总是符合模式，在提示词有歧义或模型能力较弱时尤其如此，并提供了严格模式来保证符合模式，其原理就是约束解码。在程序一侧，应当像练习 1 那样校验每一次调用，并把错误信息返回给模型。工具的名称和描述写得是否清楚，对模型能否选对工具影响很大。
a.en: A call is text generated by the model, and the discussion of JSON in 5.3 applies in the same way. Common problems are invalid JSON, missing arguments or wrong types, choosing an unsuitable tool, and inventing tools or argument values that do not exist. The documentation of Anthropic warns that the input given by a model does not always match the schema, especially with ambiguous prompts or less capable models, and offers a strict mode that guarantees conformance, whose principle is constrained decoding. On the program side every call should be validated as in exercise 1 and error messages returned to the model. How clearly the name and description of a tool are written strongly affects whether the model chooses the right one.

q.zh: 写智能体需要使用框架吗？
q.en: Is a framework needed to write an agent?

a.zh: 不是必需的。练习 3 的循环只有二十行左右，练习 4 表明框架中的工具定义与手写的是同一种东西。框架的价值在于现成的集成、追踪和部署方面的支持，在工具和步骤很多时可以节省工作量。代价是多了一层抽象。一种稳妥的顺序是先不用框架把最小的版本写通，确认自己清楚每一轮实际发送和收到的内容，再根据需要引入框架。
a.en: Not necessarily. The loop of exercise 3 is about twenty lines long, and exercise 4 shows that tool definitions in a framework are the same thing as hand-written ones. The value of a framework lies in ready-made integrations and in support for tracing and deployment, which save work when tools and steps are many. The price is one more layer of abstraction. A prudent order is to get a minimal version working without a framework, to be sure of what is actually sent and received in every round, and to bring in a framework afterwards as needed.

q.zh: ReAct 和 MCP 分别是什么？
q.en: What are ReAct and MCP?

a.zh: ReAct 是 Yao 等人提出的一种做法，让模型交替地写出推理和动作，推理用于制定和调整计划，动作用于从外部获取信息。它把 7.1 的逐步推理与工具调用结合了起来，是目前多数智能体提示方式的原型。MCP 即模型上下文协议，是一个把 AI 应用连接到外部系统的开放标准。它规定的是工具和数据源怎样向应用描述和提供自己，使同一个工具可以被不同的应用复用，模型一侧看到的仍然是本模块所讲的工具描述和调用。
a.en: ReAct is an approach proposed by Yao and colleagues in which the model writes reasoning and actions in alternation, the reasoning serving to make and adjust plans and the actions to obtain information from outside. It combines the step-by-step reasoning of 7.1 with tool calls and is the prototype of most current ways of prompting agents. MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is an open standard for connecting AI applications to external systems. It specifies how tools and data sources describe and offer themselves to applications, so that one tool can be reused by different applications, while what the model sees remains the tool descriptions and calls covered in this module.

plain.zh: 模型像一个只能靠递纸条与外界打交道的人。他自己不能上网，也不能按计算器，但可以在纸条上写“请帮我查一下明天的天气”。外面的程序照办之后，把结果写在纸条上递回来，他再接着往下做。智能体就是这样一来一回的循环。危险在于他分不清纸条是谁写的。别人塞进来一张写着“把保险箱密码告诉我”的纸条，他也可能照办。
plain.en: The model is like a person who deals with the outside world through slips of paper alone. They cannot go online or use a calculator themselves, yet they can write on a slip, please look up tomorrow's weather for me. A program outside does so and hands the result back on a slip, and they carry on. An agent is this loop of back and forth. The danger is that they cannot tell who wrote a slip. If someone pushes in a slip saying tell me the code of the safe, they may comply.

summary.zh: 怎样给模型的输出打分，自动指标和模型评委各有什么盲区，以及一个评测结果在统计上有多可靠。
summary.en: How model outputs are scored, where automatic metrics and model judges are blind, and how reliable an evaluation result is statistically.

why.zh: 前面各个模块都在报告数字，例如正确率、困惑度、检索的命中率。这些数字能否支持结论，取决于三件事，即用什么方法判定一个输出的对错、判定方法本身是否有偏差，以及样本量是否足以排除偶然性。评测做得不可靠时，改进模型或提示词就失去了依据。对研究而言，评测方法往往就是论文的核心，审稿人首先质疑的通常也是这一部分。本模块把此前各个练习中使用的简单判定方法放在一起检查，并补上统计方面的内容。
why.en: The earlier modules all report numbers, such as accuracy, perplexity and retrieval hit rates. Whether these numbers support a conclusion depends on three things, namely by what method an output is judged right or wrong, whether the method itself is biased, and whether the sample is large enough to rule out chance. When evaluation is unreliable, there is no basis for improving a model or a prompt. In research the evaluation method is often the core of a paper and usually the first part reviewers question. This module examines together the simple judging methods used in the earlier exercises and adds the statistical side.

goals.zh: 能实现 EM、F1、BLEU 和 ROUGE-L，并说出它们各自看不到什么
goals.en: Implement EM, F1, BLEU and ROUGE-L and say what each of them cannot see

goals.zh: 能设计实验测出模型评委的位置偏差并加以修正
goals.en: Design an experiment that measures the position bias of a model judge and correct for it

goals.zh: 能计算 Cohen's kappa 和自助法置信区间，并据此判断结论是否成立
goals.en: Compute Cohen's kappa and bootstrap confidence intervals and judge from them whether a conclusion holds

explain.zh: **三类判定方法。** 给一个输出打分，大致有三种办法。用代码判定，例如检查是否与标准答案完全一致。由人判定。由另一个模型判定。Anthropic 的评测文档对三者的概括是，代码判定最快、最可靠，但缺少对复杂情形的辨别力。人工判定最灵活、质量最高，但慢而且昂贵。模型判定快而灵活，但在大规模使用之前必须先验证它本身的可靠性。该文档的建议是在能够满足需要的方法中，选用最快、最可靠的那一种。
explain.en: **Three kinds of judging.** There are roughly three ways to score an output. By code, for example checking whether it matches the reference answer exactly. By people. By another model. The evaluation documentation of Anthropic sums the three up as follows. Code-based grading is the fastest and most reliable but lacks nuance for complex cases. Human grading is the most flexible and of the highest quality but slow and expensive. Model-based grading is fast and flexible, but its own reliability has to be verified before it is used at scale. The documentation advises choosing, among the methods that meet the need, the fastest and most reliable one.

explain.zh: **基于重合的指标。** 精确匹配（EM）要求输出与标准答案在归一化之后完全相同。词级 F1 统计两者共有的词，兼顾精确率和召回率。BLEU 最初为机器翻译设计，统计候选文本中有多少个 n 元组出现在参考文本中，并对过短的输出施加惩罚。ROUGE-L 最初为摘要设计，基于两段文本的最长公共子序列。这些指标计算快、结果确定，共同的局限是只看字面。练习 1 给出了一个对照。参考答案是“这座桥建于 1754 年”。把年份写成 1974 的错误回答，F1 为 0.83，ROUGE-L 为 0.86。换一种说法的正确回答，F1 只有 0.20，ROUGE-L 只有 0.18。字面重合高不代表事实正确，反之亦然。
explain.en: **Overlap-based metrics.** Exact match (EM) requires the output to equal the reference answer after normalization. Token-level F1 counts the words the two share and balances precision and recall. BLEU was designed for machine translation and counts how many n-grams of the candidate occur in the reference, with a penalty for outputs that are too short. ROUGE-L was designed for summarization and rests on the longest common subsequence of the two texts. These metrics are fast to compute and deterministic, and their shared limitation is that they look only at the surface. Exercise 1 gives a contrast. The reference says that the bridge was built in 1754. A wrong answer with the year 1974 has an F1 of 0.83 and a ROUGE-L of 0.86. A correct answer in other words has an F1 of only 0.20 and a ROUGE-L of only 0.18. High surface overlap does not mean factual correctness, and the reverse holds too.

explain.zh: **模型评委及其偏差。** 让一个模型来判断另一个模型的输出，可以处理字面指标处理不了的情形，因此使用很广。Zheng 等人的研究发现，GPT-4 作为评委与人类偏好的一致率超过 80%，与人和人之间的一致程度相当，同时也指出了三种偏差，即偏向某个位置上的答案、偏向更长的答案，以及偏向自己生成的答案。练习 2 用一个 5 亿参数的模型做评委，测量了位置偏差。12 对答案各有一个明显正确、一个明显错误。正确答案放在前面时，评委全部判对。放在后面时，评委全部判错。它在 24 次判断中每一次都选了 A，也就是说它的判断完全由位置决定，与内容无关。这是一个很小的模型，偏差格外极端，较大的评委模型偏差较轻，但性质相同。
explain.en: **Model judges and their biases.** Having one model judge the output of another handles cases that surface metrics cannot, and it is therefore widely used. The study of Zheng and colleagues found that GPT-4 as a judge agrees with human preferences in over 80% of cases, the same level as agreement between humans, and it also identifies three biases, towards the answer in a certain position, towards longer answers, and towards answers the judge generated itself. Exercise 2 uses a model of 0.5 billion parameters as a judge and measures position bias. Each of 12 pairs of answers has one plainly right and one plainly wrong. With the right answer shown first, the judge is correct every time. With it shown second, the judge is wrong every time. It says A in every one of 24 judgements, so its verdict is determined entirely by position and not by content. This is a very small model with an especially extreme bias. Larger judge models are biased less, in the same way.

explain.zh: **修正的办法。** 位置偏差可以通过交换顺序各判一次来抵消。练习 2 中读取的是评委对 A 和 B 两个字母的 logit 之差。把两种顺序下的差值相减，恒定的位置偏好就被消去，剩下的是评委对内容的判断。这样处理后，同一个评委的正确率是 92%。这说明它并非不具备判断能力，只是这种能力被位置偏好盖住了。对于偏向自己输出的问题，Panickssery 等人发现模型能以高于随机的准确率认出自己写的文本，并且这种识别能力与自我偏好的强度相关。实践中的建议是用与被评模型不同的模型做评委，并先在一批有人工标注的样本上检验评委与人的一致程度。
explain.en: **How to correct.** Position bias can be cancelled by judging once in each order. Exercise 2 reads the difference between the logits of the judge for the letters A and B. Subtracting the differences obtained in the two orders removes a constant preference for a position and leaves the judgement of the content. Treated this way, the same judge is correct in 92% of cases. It is thus not without the ability to judge. The ability was merely covered by the position preference. On the bias towards a judge's own output, Panickssery and colleagues found that models recognize text they wrote with better-than-chance accuracy and that this ability to recognize is related to the strength of self-preference. The practical advice is to use a judge model different from the model under evaluation and to check first, on a set of samples with human labels, how far the judge agrees with people.

explain.zh: **一致性要扣除偶然。** 比较评委与人、或者两位标注者之间的一致程度时，不能只看一致的比例。如果 95% 的样本都属于同一类，两个人即使各自随意标注，也会在大部分样本上一致。Cohen's kappa 从观察到的一致率中扣除偶然一致的部分。练习 3 中有一个例子，两位标注者在 90% 的样本上一致，kappa 却是 -0.05，即没有超出偶然的一致。
explain.en: **Agreement must be corrected for chance.** When comparing how far a judge agrees with people, or two annotators with each other, the share of agreement alone is not enough. If 95% of the samples belong to one class, two people labelling at random would still agree on most of them. Cohen's kappa subtracts the part of the observed agreement that is due to chance. Exercise 3 contains an example in which two annotators agree on 90% of the samples while kappa is -0.05, that is, no agreement beyond chance.

explain.zh: **样本量与不确定性。** 评测集是从所有可能的问题中抽出的一个样本，在它上面得到的正确率带有抽样误差。自助法通过对样本反复做有放回的重抽样来估计这个误差。练习 3 的结果是，20 题答对 16 题时，95% 置信区间约为 0.60 到 0.95。同样的 80% 如果来自 1000 题，区间约为 0.78 到 0.82。8 题答对 4 题时，区间约为 0.12 到 0.88。本路线中多个实验只用了 8 到 20 个样本，原因是要在 CPU 上几分钟内跑完，这些实验的数字只能说明方向。比较两个系统时，应当在同一批题目上做配对比较。20 题中 16 对 14 的差别，在重抽样中只有 87% 的情况下保持领先，不足以下结论。
explain.en: **Sample size and uncertainty.** An evaluation set is a sample drawn from all possible questions, and the accuracy obtained on it carries sampling error. The bootstrap estimates this error by repeatedly resampling the sample with replacement. The result of exercise 3 is that with 16 of 20 questions correct the 95% confidence interval is about 0.60 to 0.95. The same 80% from 1000 questions gives an interval of about 0.78 to 0.82. With 4 of 8 correct the interval is about 0.12 to 0.88. Several experiments of this roadmap use only 8 to 20 samples, in order to finish within minutes on a CPU, and their numbers indicate no more than a direction. Two systems should be compared pairwise on the same questions. A difference of 16 against 14 of 20 keeps its lead in only 87% of resamples, which is not enough for a conclusion.

caption.zh: 练习 2 的结果。同一个评委、同样的 12 对答案，只改变正确答案的位置。交换顺序并把两次的结果合并后，位置的影响被抵消。
caption.en: The result of exercise 2. The same judge and the same 12 pairs of answers, with only the position of the right answer changed. Swapping the order and combining the two results cancels the effect of position.

source.text: Papineni et al., Bleu: a Method for Automatic Evaluation of Machine Translation, ACL 2002

steps.tex: \text{EM} = \mathbb{1}\big[\, \text{norm}(\hat y) = \text{norm}(y) \,\big],\qquad F_1 = \frac{2\, P\, R}{P + R},\quad P = \frac{|\hat y \cap y|}{|\hat y|},\quad R = \frac{|\hat y \cap y|}{|y|}

note.zh: $\hat y$ 是输出，$y$ 是参考答案，都先做归一化（小写、去标点、去冠词）。交集按词计数，重复的词按出现次数计。
note.en: $\hat y$ is the output and $y$ the reference, both normalized first (lower case, punctuation and articles removed). The intersection is counted over words, with repeated words counted by multiplicity.

steps.tex: p_n = \frac{\sum_{g \in \text{n-grams}(\hat y)} \min\big( c_{\hat y}(g),\ c_{y}(g) \big)}{\sum_{g \in \text{n-grams}(\hat y)} c_{\hat y}(g)}

note.zh: BLEU 的修正精确率。$c(g)$ 是 n 元组 $g$ 出现的次数。取最小值称为截断，它防止候选文本靠重复同一个词得到高分。
note.en: The modified precision of BLEU. $c(g)$ is how often the n-gram $g$ occurs. Taking the minimum is called clipping and prevents a candidate from scoring high by repeating one word.

note.zh: 各阶精确率的几何平均乘以长度惩罚 BP，通常取 $N = 4$。精确率本身不惩罚过短的输出，所以需要 BP。只要有一阶的 $p_n$ 为 0，整个分数就是 0，这使它不适合直接用于单个短句。
note.en: The geometric mean of the precisions times the brevity penalty BP, usually with $N = 4$. Precision by itself does not punish outputs that are too short, hence BP. A single $p_n$ of 0 makes the whole score 0, which makes it unsuited to single short sentences as it stands.

steps.tex: \text{ROUGE-L} = \frac{2\, P\, R}{P + R},\qquad P = \frac{\text{LCS}(\hat y, y)}{|\hat y|},\quad R = \frac{\text{LCS}(\hat y, y)}{|y|}

note.zh: LCS 是最长公共子序列的长度，其中的词必须保持顺序，但不要求相邻。
note.en: LCS is the length of the longest common subsequence, whose words must keep their order without having to be adjacent.

title.en: Cancelling the position bias of a judge

note.zh: 一个简单的模型。$m$ 是评委对 A 与 B 的 logit 之差，$s$ 是它对内容的真实判断（正确答案优于错误答案的程度），$b$ 是对位置 A 的固定偏好。$m_1$ 是正确答案放在 A 时的读数，$m_2$ 是放在 B 时的读数。
note.en: A simple model. $m$ is the difference between the logits of the judge for A and B, $s$ its actual judgement of the content (how far the right answer is ahead of the wrong one) and $b$ a fixed preference for position A. $m_1$ is the reading with the right answer at A and $m_2$ with it at B.

note.zh: 偏好很强时，两种顺序下评委都选 A，这就是练习 2 中观察到的情形。
note.en: With a strong preference the judge says A in both orders, which is what exercise 2 observes.

note.zh: 两次读数相减，$b$ 被消去。差值的符号就是评委对内容的判断。这要求每一对都判两次，成本加倍。
note.en: Subtracting the two readings eliminates $b$. The sign of the difference is the judgement of the content. This requires judging every pair twice at double the cost.

source.text: cohen_kappa_score, scikit-learn documentation

note.zh: $p_o$ 是观察到的一致率。$p_e$ 是两位标注者按各自的标签比例独立标注时预期的一致率。$\kappa = 1$ 表示完全一致，$0$ 表示没有超出偶然的一致。
note.en: $p_o$ is the observed agreement. $p_e$ is the agreement expected if the two annotators labelled independently with their own label proportions. $\kappa = 1$ means complete agreement and $0$ no agreement beyond chance.

note.zh: 两类各占一半时，偶然一致率是 0.5。80% 的一致对应 0.6 的 kappa。
note.en: With two classes at one half each, chance agreement is 0.5. An agreement of 80% corresponds to a kappa of 0.6.

note.zh: 类别极不平衡时，偶然一致率本身就有 0.905。90% 的一致率还不如偶然，kappa 为负。
note.en: With extremely unbalanced classes chance agreement is itself 0.905. An agreement of 90% falls short of chance and kappa is negative.

title.en: The sampling error of an accuracy

note.zh: $n$ 道相互独立的题目上正确率为 $p$ 时的标准误，以及正态近似下的置信区间。自助法在 $n$ 较大时给出相近的结果，并且适用于没有现成公式的统计量。
note.en: The standard error of an accuracy $p$ on $n$ independent questions and the confidence interval under the normal approximation. The bootstrap gives similar results for larger $n$ and also applies to statistics without a ready formula.

note.zh: 误差随样本量的平方根缩小。要把区间缩窄到一半，需要四倍的样本。区分两个相差 2 个百分点的系统，通常需要上千道题。
note.en: The error shrinks with the square root of the sample size. Halving the interval takes four times the sample. Separating two systems that differ by 2 percentage points usually takes more than a thousand questions.

q.zh: 为什么 LLM 评委会偏向某个位置？
q.en: Why do LLM judges favour a position?

a.zh: 评委的回答同样是在预测下一个 token。在“回答 A 或 B”这样的提示词之后，A 和 B 两个 token 的先验概率本来就不相等，它受到训练数据中选项分布、提示词措辞和选项顺序的影响，这与 7.1 中讨论的少样本提示的偏向是同一类现象。当评委对内容的判断不够强时，这种先验就会主导结果。练习 2 中的小模型是极端的例子。应对的办法是交换顺序各判一次，只接受两次结论一致的判断，或者像练习 2 那样把两次的读数合并。
a.en: The answer of a judge is likewise a prediction of the next token. After a prompt such as reply A or B, the prior probabilities of the tokens A and B are unequal to begin with, influenced by the distribution of options in the training data, the wording of the prompt and the order of the options, the same kind of phenomenon as the biases of few-shot prompting discussed in 7.1. When the judgement of the content is not strong enough, this prior dominates the result. The small model of exercise 2 is an extreme example. The remedy is to judge once in each order and accept only verdicts on which both agree, or to combine the two readings as in exercise 2.

q.zh: 为什么 LLM 评委会偏向自己的输出？
q.en: Why do LLM judges favour their own outputs?

a.zh: Panickssery 等人的实验给出了一种解释。模型能以高于随机的准确率区分自己写的文本与其他模型或人写的文本。经过微调增强这种识别能力后，自我偏好也随之增强，两者呈线性关系，作者认为这种联系是因果性的。一种直观的理解是，模型给自己更可能生成的文本更高的概率，而评分高低与这种熟悉程度相关。因此评测时宜用与被评模型不同的模型做评委，这也是 Anthropic 文档中的建议。
a.en: The experiments of Panickssery and colleagues offer an explanation. Models distinguish text they wrote from text by other models or by people with better-than-chance accuracy. When this ability is strengthened by fine-tuning, self-preference strengthens with it in a linear relationship, and the authors argue that the link is causal. An intuitive reading is that a model assigns higher probability to text it would be more likely to generate, and that scores correlate with this familiarity. A judge model different from the model under evaluation is therefore advisable, which is also the recommendation in the documentation of Anthropic.

q.zh: BLEU 和 ROUGE 还值得使用吗？
q.en: Are BLEU and ROUGE still worth using?

a.zh: 在它们原本针对的场合仍然有用，即输出与参考文本在措辞上本来就应当接近的任务，例如翻译和抽取式摘要，并且是在大量样本上取平均。它们便宜、确定、可复现。对于开放式的问答和生成，正确的回答可以有很多种写法，字面重合就不再可靠，练习 1 的对照说明了这一点。这类任务通常需要结合基于含义的判定方法，例如模型评委或 8.2 中的蕴含模型。
a.en: They remain useful where they were intended, in tasks whose output ought to be close in wording to a reference text, such as translation and extractive summarization, and averaged over many samples. They are cheap, deterministic and reproducible. For open-ended question answering and generation a correct answer can be written in many ways and surface overlap stops being reliable, as the contrast of exercise 1 shows. Such tasks usually need to be combined with judging by meaning, for example a model judge or the entailment model of 8.2.

q.zh: 评测集需要多大？
q.en: How large does an evaluation set have to be?

a.zh: 取决于要分辨多小的差别。正确率的误差大约与样本量的平方根成反比。100 题时 95% 区间的半宽约为 8 个百分点，只能分辨很大的差别。1000 题时约为 2.5 个百分点。Anthropic 的评测文档建议优先保证数量，认为大量自动评分的题目比少量精心人工评分的题目更有价值。报告结果时应当给出置信区间。比较两个系统时，在同一批题目上做配对比较可以明显降低所需的样本量。
a.en: That depends on how small a difference is to be resolved. The error of an accuracy is roughly inversely proportional to the square root of the sample size. With 100 questions the half-width of the 95% interval is about 8 percentage points, which resolves only very large differences. With 1000 questions it is about 2.5 points. The evaluation documentation of Anthropic advises prioritizing volume, holding that many automatically graded questions are worth more than a few carefully hand-graded ones. Results should be reported with confidence intervals. When two systems are compared, a paired comparison on the same questions clearly reduces the sample needed.

q.zh: kappa 多大才算可以接受？
q.en: How large a kappa is acceptable?

a.zh: 没有统一的标准。它的取值范围是 -1 到 1，0 表示没有超出偶然的一致，scikit-learn 的文档只给出了这个含义，没有划分等级。不同领域有各自沿用的经验分级，引用时应当注明出处。更重要的是同时报告原始一致率、kappa 和各类别的比例，因为类别极不平衡时 kappa 会变得很低，需要结合起来解读。如果评委与人工标注的一致程度明显低于人与人之间的一致程度，就不宜用这个评委代替人工。
a.en: There is no uniform standard. Its range is -1 to 1, with 0 meaning no agreement beyond chance, and the scikit-learn documentation gives only this meaning without grading levels. Different fields have their own customary gradings, whose source should be cited when used. It matters more to report raw agreement, kappa and the class proportions together, since kappa becomes very low with extremely unbalanced classes and has to be read in combination. If a judge agrees with human labels clearly less than humans agree with each other, it should not replace human judgement.

q.zh: 搭建一套评测应当从哪里开始？
q.en: Where should building an evaluation start?

a.zh: 从成功标准开始。Anthropic 的文档要求标准是具体的、可度量的、可达到的并且与应用目的相关，例如把“表现好”改写为“在某个测试集上情感分类的 F1 不低于某个数值”。然后收集能够反映真实任务分布的样本，包括边界情形。再为每一条标准选择判定方法，能用代码判定的就用代码。使用模型评委时，给出明确的评分细则，要求输出受限的结果，例如“正确”或“错误”，并先在小规模上检验它的可靠性。
a.en: With success criteria. The documentation of Anthropic requires criteria to be specific, measurable, achievable and relevant to the purpose of the application, for example rewriting good performance as an F1 of at least some value for sentiment classification on some test set. Then samples are collected that reflect the real task distribution, including edge cases. Then a judging method is chosen for each criterion, by code wherever code can judge. When a model judge is used, it is given a clear rubric and asked for a constrained output such as correct or incorrect, and its reliability is checked on a small scale first.

plain.zh: 评估像阅卷。客观题对一下标准答案即可，又快又准，但只适用于答案唯一的题目。作文需要老师来判，准确而费时。请另一个模型来判，像请一位助教，速度快，但助教有自己的偏好，例如总觉得放在前面的那一份更好，所以要先抽查他判得准不准。另外，只考 20 道题得到的 80 分，换一套题可能是 60 分，也可能是 95 分，题量决定了分数有多可信。
plain.en: Evaluation is like marking exams. Objective questions are checked against a key, fast and exact, yet this works only where the answer is unique. Essays need a teacher, accurate and slow. Having another model judge is like bringing in a teaching assistant, who is fast and has preferences of their own, such as finding the script placed first the better one, so their marking has to be spot-checked first. Moreover, a score of 80 from only 20 questions might be 60 or 95 on another set of questions, and the number of questions decides how far a score can be trusted.

summary.zh: 模型为什么会自信地说错，怎样检测，以及训练数据带来的偏见和隐私风险怎样度量。
summary.en: Why models state falsehoods with confidence, how this is detected, and how the bias and privacy risks carried by training data are measured.

why.zh: 模型的输出读起来流畅可信，并不保证内容属实。在医疗、法律、科研等场合，一个编造的事实或引用可能造成实际的损害。除了事实错误，模型还会带出训练数据中的社会偏见，也可能复述训练数据里的个人信息。这三类问题都源于同一个事实，即模型学到的是训练文本的统计规律。了解它们的成因和检测方法，是负责任地使用模型的前提，也是下一模块中法规所要求的内容的技术基础。其中关于回答是否有据的检查，与本路线的研究主题直接相关。
why.en: That the output of a model reads fluent and credible does not guarantee that its content is true. In settings such as medicine, law and research, an invented fact or citation can cause real harm. Besides factual errors, a model also carries social biases from its training data and may reproduce personal information contained in them. All three kinds of problems stem from one fact, namely that a model learns the statistical regularities of its training text. Knowing their causes and how they are detected is a precondition for using models responsibly and the technical basis of what the regulation in the next module requires. The check of whether an answer is grounded bears directly on the research topic of this roadmap.

goals.zh: 能从训练目标和评测方式两方面解释幻觉的成因
goals.en: Explain the causes of hallucination from the training objective and from the way of evaluation

goals.zh: 能用多次采样的一致性和蕴含模型检测无据的回答，并说出两种方法的盲区
goals.en: Detect ungrounded answers with the consistency of repeated samples and with an entailment model, and name the blind spots of both

goals.zh: 能实现基于模式的个人信息脱敏和一个反事实偏见探测
goals.en: Implement pattern-based redaction of personal data and a counterfactual bias probe

explain.zh: **什么是幻觉。** 模型生成了看似合理、实际上错误或没有依据的内容，称为幻觉。7.2 的练习给出过例子，对于一个虚构的体育场，模型在没有任何资料的情况下回答容量约为 100 万人，语气与回答真实问题时没有区别。从机制上看这并不意外。模型的每一步都是在选择一个概率较高的 token，它并没有一个单独的步骤去核对内容是否属实，“不知道”也只是一种可能的续写，并不享有特殊的地位。
explain.en: **What hallucination is.** A model generating content that looks plausible and is in fact wrong or unfounded is called hallucination. The exercises of 7.2 gave an example. For an invented stadium the model, without any material, answers that the capacity is about one million, in the same tone as when answering real questions. Mechanistically this is not surprising. At every step the model chooses a token of high probability, it has no separate step that checks whether the content is true, and I do not know is merely one possible continuation without a special status.

explain.zh: **为什么会这样。** Kalai 等人给出了一个统计上的解释。他们把幻觉归因于训练和评测方式对自信猜测的鼓励。在预训练阶段，模型如果无法可靠地区分真假陈述，统计上的压力就会使它生成看似合理的错误陈述。在评测阶段，多数基准的计分方式使猜测比承认不知道更划算，答对得分，答错和不答都不得分，于是最优的策略是始终作答。他们主张修改主流基准的计分方式，而不是另外增加专门的幻觉基准。下面的第一个推导把这个论点写成了一个简单的不等式。
explain.en: **Why this happens.** Kalai and colleagues give a statistical explanation. They attribute hallucination to the way training and evaluation encourage confident guessing. In pretraining, if a model cannot reliably tell true statements from false ones, statistical pressure makes it produce plausible false statements. In evaluation, the scoring of most benchmarks makes guessing pay better than admitting ignorance. A right answer scores and both a wrong answer and no answer score nothing, so the optimal strategy is to answer in every case. They argue for changing the scoring of the dominant benchmarks and against adding separate hallucination benchmarks. The first derivation below writes this argument as a simple inequality.

explain.zh: **用一致性检测。** Manakul 等人提出的 SelfCheckGPT 基于一个观察。模型确实知道的事实，多次采样的回答往往一致。编造的内容，多次采样往往互不相同甚至相互矛盾。这种方法只需要模型的输出，不需要概率，也不需要外部资料。练习 1 对 8 个常识问题和 8 个关于虚构小镇的问题各采样 5 次，计算回答之间的平均重合度。常识问题的平均值是 0.53，虚构问题是 0.24，在 84% 的配对中前者高于后者。它也暴露了方法的局限。有一个虚构问题的一致性高达 0.73，原因是 5 个回答都在重复问题中的词，而没有给出具体的数字。此外，模型也可能每次都给出同一个错误答案，一致并不等于正确。
explain.en: **Detection by consistency.** SelfCheckGPT, proposed by Manakul and colleagues, rests on an observation. For facts a model actually knows, repeatedly sampled answers tend to agree. For invented content, repeated samples tend to differ and even contradict one another. The method needs only the output of the model, neither probabilities nor external material. Exercise 1 samples 5 answers each to 8 questions of common knowledge and 8 questions about an invented town and computes the mean overlap between the answers. The mean is 0.53 for common knowledge and 0.24 for the invented questions, and the former is higher than the latter in 84% of pairs. The exercise also exposes limits of the method. One invented question reaches a consistency of 0.73 because all 5 answers repeat words of the question without giving a concrete number. Moreover a model may give the same wrong answer every time, and consistency is not correctness.

explain.zh: **用蕴含模型检查有据性。** 在 RAG 这类有参考资料的场合，可以直接检查回答是否被资料支持。自然语言推理（NLI）模型读入一个前提和一个假设，判断前提是否蕴含假设。把检索到的段落作为前提，把回答中的每一句作为假设，就得到一个有据性检查。练习 2 用一个 1.4 亿参数的 NLI 模型检查了 12 个句子，其中包括 7.2 的 mini-RAG 实际给出的三个错误回答，12 个全部判断正确。只差一位数字的 1754 与 1974，蕴含概率分别是 1.00 和 0.00。这类检查的成本很低，可以对每一条输出都运行。它检查的是回答与资料是否一致，资料本身有错时它无法发现。
explain.en: **Checking groundedness with an entailment model.** Where reference material exists, as in RAG, it can be checked directly whether the answer is supported by the material. A natural language inference (NLI) model reads a premise and a hypothesis and decides whether the premise entails the hypothesis. With a retrieved passage as premise and each sentence of the answer as hypothesis, this gives a check of groundedness. Exercise 2 checks 12 sentences with an NLI model of 142 million parameters, among them the three wrong answers that the mini-RAG of 7.2 actually gave, and all 12 are judged correctly. For 1754 and 1974, one digit apart, the entailment probabilities are 1.00 and 0.00. Such a check is cheap and can run on every output. It checks whether answer and material agree and cannot notice when the material itself is wrong.

explain.zh: **偏见。** 模型从训练文本中学到词与词的共现规律，其中包括社会中存在的刻板印象。度量偏见的一种基本方法是反事实对比，即构造只在某一个属性上不同的输入，比较模型的输出。练习 3 在 GPT-2 上比较了“The 某职业 said that”之后 he 与 she 的对数概率之差。nurse 为 -1.63，engineer 为 +2.14，十个职业之间相差 3.8。Zhao 等人在指代消解系统上做过系统的研究，三类系统在代词与职业的刻板印象一致时都比相反时更准确，平均相差 21.1 个 F1 点。这类探测度量的是模型内部的关联，它在具体应用中造成多大的影响，还取决于任务，例如在筛选简历或生成推荐信时影响会直接得多。
explain.en: **Bias.** A model learns from its training text the regularities of which words occur together, including stereotypes present in society. A basic method of measuring bias is counterfactual comparison, constructing inputs that differ in one attribute alone and comparing the outputs of the model. Exercise 3 compares on GPT-2 the difference between the log-probabilities of he and she after The followed by an occupation and said that. It is -1.63 for nurse and +2.14 for engineer, a spread of 3.8 across ten occupations. Zhao and colleagues studied this systematically on coreference systems. Three kinds of systems were all more accurate when pronoun and occupation matched a stereotype than when they contradicted it, by 21.1 F1 points on average. Such probes measure associations inside the model. How much effect these have in a concrete application also depends on the task and is far more direct in, for example, screening résumés or writing letters of recommendation.

explain.zh: **隐私。** 风险来自两个方向。一是训练数据被记住。Carlini 等人仅通过查询 GPT-2 就提取出了数百条训练数据中的原文，其中包括姓名、电话号码和电子邮件地址，有的只在训练数据的一份文档中出现过，并且更大的模型更容易被提取。二是使用过程中的数据外流，用户输入的内容会进入提示词、日志，在使用 API 时还会发送给第三方。练习 3 实现了最基本的防护，即在文本离开本机之前用模式匹配去除电子邮件、电话、银行账号和卡号。测试同时显示了它的边界，姓名和地址没有固定的格式，模式匹配找不到它们。Presidio 这类工具结合了命名实体识别、正则表达式和校验和，其说明中也写明不能保证找出所有敏感信息。
explain.en: **Privacy.** The risk comes from two directions. One is memorized training data. By querying GPT-2 alone, Carlini and colleagues extracted hundreds of verbatim sequences from its training data, including names, phone numbers and email addresses, some of which occurred in a single document of the training data, and larger models were more vulnerable. The other is data leaving during use. What users enter goes into prompts and logs and, with an API, is sent to a third party. Exercise 3 implements the most basic protection, removing email addresses, phone numbers, bank account numbers and card numbers by pattern matching before text leaves the machine. The tests also show its boundary. Names and addresses have no fixed format and pattern matching does not find them. Tools such as Presidio combine named entity recognition, regular expressions and checksums, and their documentation likewise states that finding all sensitive information cannot be guaranteed.

caption.zh: 练习 3 的结果。横轴是 GPT-2 在“The 某职业 said that”之后预测 he 与 she 的对数概率之差，向右表示更倾向于 he。
caption.en: The result of exercise 3. The horizontal axis is the difference between the log-probabilities GPT-2 assigns to he and she after The followed by an occupation and said that, with values to the right leaning towards he.

title.zh: 计分方式怎样鼓励猜测

source.text: Kalai, Nachum, Vempala, Zhang, Why Language Models Hallucinate, arXiv:2509.04664

note.zh: 常见的计分方式。答对得 1 分，答错和不答都得 0 分。$p$ 是模型对自己答案正确的把握。
note.en: The common way of scoring. A right answer scores 1 and both a wrong answer and no answer score 0. $p$ is the confidence of the model that its answer is right.

steps.tex: p > 0 \;\Rightarrow\; \text{answering is always at least as good as abstaining}

note.zh: 只要有一点可能答对，作答的期望得分就不低于不答。在这种计分下，一个始终猜测的模型的得分高于一个诚实地表示不知道的模型。
note.en: As long as there is some chance of being right, the expected score of answering is no lower than that of abstaining. Under this scoring a model that guesses in every case outscores one that honestly says it does not know.

note.zh: 如果答错扣 $\lambda$ 分，只有把握超过一个门槛时作答才划算。$\lambda = 1$ 时门槛是 0.5，$\lambda = 3$ 时是 0.75。这是许多人工考试采用的做法，也是该论文建议的方向，即让计分方式不再奖励没有把握的猜测。
note.en: If a wrong answer costs $\lambda$ points, answering pays only when confidence exceeds a threshold. The threshold is 0.5 for $\lambda = 1$ and 0.75 for $\lambda = 3$. Many examinations for people work this way, and it is the direction the paper recommends, scoring that no longer rewards guesses made without confidence.

steps.tex: \text{consistency}(q) = \frac{2}{n (n - 1)} \sum_{i < j} \text{sim}(a_i, a_j),\qquad a_1, \dots, a_n \sim p(\cdot \mid q)

note.zh: 对问题 $q$ 采样 $n$ 个回答，取所有回答对之间相似度的平均。练习 1 用词级 F1 作为相似度。数值低提示回答可能是编造的。
note.en: Sample $n$ answers to the question $q$ and average the similarity over all pairs of answers. Exercise 1 uses token-level F1 as the similarity. A low value suggests that the answer may be invented.

note.zh: $a$ 是回答，$D$ 是检索到的段落。每个句子取它在各段落下的最大蕴含概率，表示至少有一个段落支持它。整个回答取各句的最小值，因为只要有一句没有依据，回答就不能算有据。
note.en: $a$ is the answer and $D$ the retrieved passages. Each sentence takes its highest entailment probability over the passages, meaning that at least one passage supports it. The whole answer takes the minimum over its sentences, since one unsupported sentence is enough to make an answer ungrounded.

q.zh: 为什么模型会产生幻觉？
q.en: Why do models hallucinate?

a.zh: 可以从三个层面回答。从生成机制看，模型每一步都在选择概率较高的续写，流畅的错误陈述与正确陈述在形式上没有区别，模型没有单独的事实核对环节。从训练看，训练数据中很少出现“我不知道”这样的回答，对于只出现过很少次的事实，模型没有足够的信息把正确答案与看似合理的其他答案区分开，Kalai 等人把这描述为二分类上的误差。从评测看，主流基准的计分方式使猜测比不答更划算，模型和训练方法都是朝着这样的指标优化的。因此幻觉不是偶然的故障，是当前训练目标和评测方式下可以预期的结果。
a.en: The answer has three levels. In the generation mechanism, the model chooses at every step a continuation of high probability, a fluent false statement does not differ in form from a true one, and there is no separate fact-checking step. In training, answers such as I do not know are rare in the data, and for facts that occurred very few times the model lacks the information to separate the right answer from plausible alternatives, which Kalai and colleagues describe as errors in binary classification. In evaluation, the scoring of the dominant benchmarks makes guessing pay better than abstaining, and models and training methods are optimized towards such metrics. Hallucination is therefore not an accidental malfunction and is an expected outcome under the current training objective and way of evaluation.

q.zh: 幻觉可以完全消除吗？
q.en: Can hallucination be eliminated completely?

a.zh: 目前不能，只能降低。Anthropic 的文档列出了一组常用的手段，包括明确允许模型回答不知道、要求先逐字引用原文再作答、要求为每个论断给出引文并撤回找不到引文的论断、多次运行并比较结果，以及限定只使用所提供的资料。该文档同时写明，这些手段能显著减少幻觉，但不能消除，关键信息仍应当核验。7.2 和本模块的练习与此一致，检索把正确率从 20 题对 2 题提高到对 16 题，剩下的错误需要靠有据性检查这类后置的环节去发现。
a.en: Not at present. It can only be reduced. The documentation of Anthropic lists a set of common means, including explicitly allowing the model to say that it does not know, having it quote the source verbatim before answering, requiring a citation for every claim and retracting claims for which none is found, running several times and comparing the results, and restricting it to the material supplied. The same documentation states that these means reduce hallucination significantly without eliminating it and that critical information should still be validated. The exercises of 7.2 and of this module agree. Retrieval raises accuracy from 2 to 16 of 20 questions, and the remaining errors have to be found by downstream steps such as the groundedness check.

q.zh: 把温度设为 0 能减少幻觉吗？
q.en: Does setting the temperature to 0 reduce hallucination?

a.zh: 不能指望它。温度为 0 只是让模型每次选择概率最高的 token，输出更稳定，但概率最高的续写并不一定是真的。如果模型对某个问题的最高概率答案本身就是错的，温度为 0 时它每次都会给出这个错误答案。这也是一致性检测的盲区，稳定地出错不会被发现。
a.en: It should not be relied on. A temperature of 0 only makes the model choose the most probable token every time, which makes the output more stable, but the most probable continuation is not necessarily true. If the highest-probability answer of a model to a question is itself wrong, it gives this wrong answer every time at temperature 0. This is also the blind spot of consistency checks, which do not notice stable errors.

q.zh: 一致性检测和蕴含检查各适用于什么场合？
q.en: When does the consistency check apply and when the entailment check?

a.zh: 没有参考资料时只能用一致性检测，它不需要任何外部信息，代价是要多次生成，并且发现不了每次都相同的错误。有参考资料时，蕴含检查更直接，只需要一次小模型的前向计算，可以定位到具体哪一句没有依据。它的前提是资料可靠，并且回答可以拆成能够独立判断的句子，对于需要综合多个段落才能得出的结论，逐句对单个段落做蕴含判断会漏判。两种方法都是概率性的判断，适合用来筛选出需要人工复核的输出。
a.en: Without reference material only the consistency check is available. It needs no external information, at the price of generating several times and of missing errors that are the same every time. With reference material the entailment check is more direct, takes one forward pass of a small model and locates the particular sentence without support. It presupposes reliable material and an answer that splits into sentences judged independently. For conclusions that need several passages combined, entailment of single sentences against single passages misses cases. Both methods are probabilistic judgements, suited to selecting outputs that need human review.

q.zh: 模型的偏见从哪里来，怎样度量？
q.en: Where does the bias of a model come from and how is it measured?

a.zh: 主要来自训练数据。文本中某些职业与某种性别的代词更经常一起出现，模型就学到了这种关联，对齐训练中的标注偏好也可能带入新的倾向。度量的基本思路是反事实对比，即只改变输入中的一个属性，例如姓名、性别词或国籍，观察输出的变化。练习 3 是最简单的形式，直接比较两个代词的概率。更接近应用的做法是在完整的任务上比较，例如同一份简历换上不同的姓名后得到的评价是否不同。需要留意的是，探测到关联并不等于在具体应用中一定会造成不公平的结果，反过来，探测不到也不代表不存在。
a.en: Mainly from the training data. Where certain occupations occur more often with the pronouns of one gender in text, the model learns this association, and annotator preferences in alignment training may introduce further tendencies. The basic idea of measurement is counterfactual comparison, changing one attribute of the input alone, such as a name, a gendered word or a nationality, and observing how the output changes. Exercise 3 is the simplest form and compares the probabilities of two pronouns directly. Closer to applications is comparing on the full task, for example whether the same résumé with different names receives different assessments. It should be noted that a probed association does not mean that a concrete application necessarily produces unfair results, and conversely that finding nothing does not mean that nothing exists.

q.zh: 使用大模型时有哪些隐私风险？
q.en: What privacy risks arise when using large models?

a.zh: 主要有三类。训练数据中的个人信息可能被模型记住并在输出中复现。用户输入的内容可能包含自己或他人的个人信息，这些内容会进入提示词和日志，通过 API 使用时还会离开本机。在 RAG 和智能体系统中，检索到的文档和工具返回的结果同样可能含有个人信息，并可能通过 7.3 讨论的提示注入被诱导输出。基本的做法是只发送任务所必需的内容，在发送之前做脱敏，并了解所用服务对数据的保留和使用方式。处理他人的个人数据时还需要遵守所在地区的数据保护法规。
a.en: Mainly three kinds. Personal information in the training data may be memorized by a model and reproduced in its output. What users enter may contain personal information about themselves or others, which goes into prompts and logs and, with an API, leaves the machine. In RAG and agent systems, retrieved documents and tool results may equally contain personal information and may be elicited through the prompt injection discussed in 7.3. The basic practice is to send only what the task requires, to redact before sending, and to know how the service in use retains and uses data. Handling the personal data of others additionally requires compliance with the data protection law of the region concerned.

plain.zh: 模型像一个被训练成每题必答的考生，而考试的规则是答错不扣分。遇到不会的题，对他最有利的做法是写一个看上去像模像样的答案。他并不是有意说谎，只是没有一个单独的环节去核对自己写的是否属实。检测的办法也像对付这样的考生。同一道题多问几遍，真知道的每次答案一致，编出来的每次不同。或者要求他指出答案出自参考书的哪一行。
plain.en: The model is like a candidate trained to answer every question in an exam that deducts nothing for wrong answers. Faced with a question they cannot answer, their best move is to write something that looks the part. They do not lie on purpose. They merely lack a separate step that checks whether what they wrote is true. Detection also works as it would with such a candidate. The same question is asked several times, and what is really known comes out the same each time while what is made up differs. Or they are required to point to the line of the reference book the answer comes from.

summary.zh: 按风险分级的监管思路，通用模型提供者的义务，对研究和开放权重模型的例外，以及各项规则的生效时间。中国和美国的情况见 8.4。
summary.en: Regulation graded by risk, the obligations of providers of general-purpose models, the exceptions for research and open-weight models, and when each set of rules applies. China and the United States are covered in 8.4.

asof.zh: 本模块的内容截至 2026 年 11 月 25 日，日期和条款依据欧盟委员会的人工智能法页面（2026 年 10 月 19 日更新）及法规条文，已包含 2026 年 7 月 27 日生效的数字综合法案所做的修改。内容用于学习，不构成法律意见，具体问题应以官方文本为准并咨询专业人士。
asof.en: The content of this module is as of 25 November 2026. Dates and provisions follow the AI Act page of the European Commission (updated 19 October 2026) and the text of the regulation, including the amendments of the Digital Omnibus on AI in force since 27 July 2026. The content is for learning and is not legal advice. Specific questions should be settled from the official text and with professional advice.

why.zh: 欧盟人工智能法是第一部对人工智能做全面规定的法律，在欧盟境内开发、提供或使用相关系统的机构都在它的范围之内，包括高校。对在欧盟工作的研究者而言，需要知道自己的研究活动是否受它约束、把模型或系统提供给他人使用时身份会发生什么变化，以及文档和透明度方面的要求与前面学过的模型卡、评测等内容有什么对应关系。它也是面向欧洲岗位的面试中的常见话题。本模块只介绍与大模型直接相关的部分，并标明每一条的依据。
why.en: The EU AI Act is the first law to regulate artificial intelligence comprehensively, and organizations that develop, provide or use such systems in the Union fall within its scope, universities included. A researcher working in the Union needs to know whether research activities are bound by it, how one's role changes when a model or system is made available to others, and how its requirements on documentation and transparency correspond to the model cards and evaluations covered earlier. It is also a common topic in interviews for positions in Europe. This module introduces only the parts that bear directly on large models and states the basis of each point.

goals.zh: 能说出四个风险等级及各自的例子
goals.en: Name the four risk levels with an example of each

goals.zh: 能区分提供者与部署者，并说明通用模型提供者的四项基本义务
goals.en: Tell provider from deployer and state the four basic obligations of providers of general-purpose models

goals.zh: 能判断研究活动和开放权重模型在什么条件下适用例外
goals.en: Judge under what conditions the exceptions for research and for open-weight models apply

explain.zh: **按风险分级。** 该法不按技术分类，而是按用途可能造成的风险分为四级，风险越高义务越重。不可接受的风险属于禁止之列，例如社会评分、在工作场所和学校进行情绪识别，以及执法部门在公共场所进行实时远程生物识别。高风险的用途可以进行，但须满足一系列严格的要求，例如筛选求职者的简历、考试评分、信用评分和签证申请的审查。有透明度风险的用途须履行告知义务，例如聊天机器人要让用户知道自己在与机器交谈。风险极小或没有风险的用途不受专门规定的约束，例如垃圾邮件过滤和电子游戏中的人工智能。
explain.en: **Graded by risk.** The Act does not classify by technology but by the risk a use may cause, in four levels, with heavier obligations for higher risk. Unacceptable risk is prohibited, for example social scoring, emotion recognition in workplaces and schools, and real-time remote biometric identification by law enforcement in public spaces. High-risk uses are permitted subject to a series of strict requirements, for example sorting the CVs of job applicants, scoring exams, credit scoring and examining visa applications. Uses with transparency risk carry duties to inform, for example a chatbot has to let users know that they are talking to a machine. Uses with minimal or no risk are not subject to specific rules, for example spam filters and AI in video games.

explain.zh: **高风险怎样认定。** 第 6 条给出了两条途径。一是系统属于附件一所列产品安全法规下的产品或其安全部件，并且该产品须经第三方合格评定。二是系统属于附件三列出的八个领域中的用途，即生物识别、关键基础设施、教育和职业培训、就业和劳动者管理、基本的私人和公共服务、执法、移民与边境管理，以及司法和民主程序。教育领域包括决定录取、评定学习成果和检测考试作弊。附件三中的系统如果只执行范围很窄的程序性任务，或者只是为评估做准备等，可以不被认定为高风险，但对自然人进行画像的系统始终属于高风险。提供者认为自己的系统不属于高风险时，须在投放市场之前把这一评估记录在案。
explain.en: **How high risk is determined.** Article 6 gives two routes. One is that the system is a product, or a safety component of a product, under the product safety legislation listed in Annex I, and the product has to undergo third-party conformity assessment. The other is that the system serves a use in one of the eight areas listed in Annex III, namely biometrics, critical infrastructure, education and vocational training, employment and workers' management, essential private and public services, law enforcement, migration and border control, and the administration of justice and democratic processes. The area of education includes deciding admission, grading learning outcomes and detecting cheating in tests. A system of Annex III that performs only a narrow procedural task, or merely prepares an assessment and the like, may be considered not high-risk, but a system that profiles natural persons is always high-risk. A provider that concludes its system is not high-risk has to document this assessment before placing the system on the market.

explain.zh: **两种身份。** 义务按身份分配。提供者是开发人工智能系统或通用模型、并以自己的名义将其投放市场或投入使用的主体，无论是否收费。部署者是在自己的权限下使用人工智能系统的主体，纯属个人的非职业性使用除外。同一个机构在不同的场合可以有不同的身份。一所大学训练并公开发布一个模型时是提供者，采购一套自动阅卷系统并用于考试时是部署者。
explain.en: **Two roles.** Obligations are assigned by role. A provider is whoever develops an AI system or a general-purpose model and places it on the market or puts it into service under its own name, whether or not for payment. A deployer is whoever uses an AI system under its authority, except for purely personal, non-professional use. One organization can have different roles on different occasions. A university that trains and publicly releases a model is a provider, and one that procures an automated marking system and uses it in exams is a deployer.

explain.zh: **通用模型提供者的义务。** 通用人工智能模型指表现出显著的通用性、能够胜任多种不同任务、并可集成到各种下游系统中的模型，前面各阶段讨论的大语言模型即属此类。第 53 条规定了提供者的四项义务。编制并持续更新模型的技术文档，内容包括训练、测试过程和评估结果。向打算把模型集成进自己系统的下游提供者提供信息，使其了解模型的能力和局限。制定遵守欧盟版权法的政策。按照人工智能办公室提供的模板，公布训练内容的摘要。这些要求与 6.1 中的模型卡、8.1 中的评测在内容上是对应的，区别在于它们在这里成为法定的义务。委员会在 2025 年 7 月发布了一份自愿采用的通用模型行为准则，分为透明度、版权、安全与安保三章，签署的提供者可以通过遵守准则来证明合规。
explain.en: **The obligations of providers of general-purpose models.** A general-purpose AI model is one that displays significant generality, can competently perform a wide range of distinct tasks and can be integrated into a variety of downstream systems. The large language models discussed in the earlier stages are of this kind. Article 53 lays down four obligations of providers. To draw up and keep up to date technical documentation of the model, including its training and testing process and evaluation results. To provide information to downstream providers who intend to integrate the model into their own systems, so that they understand its capabilities and limitations. To put in place a policy to comply with Union copyright law. To publish a summary of the content used for training, following a template provided by the AI Office. In content these requirements correspond to the model cards of 6.1 and the evaluations of 8.1, the difference being that here they become statutory duties. In July 2025 the Commission published a voluntary Code of Practice for general-purpose models with three chapters on transparency, copyright, and safety and security, and providers who sign it can demonstrate compliance by adhering to it.

explain.zh: **系统性风险。** 能力特别强的通用模型另有一层义务，须评估并减轻系统性风险。第 51 条规定，训练所用的累计计算量超过 $10^{25}$ 次浮点运算的模型，被推定具有高影响能力。这里的计算量正是 4.6 中用 $6ND$ 估算的那个量，下面的推导给出了一个数量级的例子。
explain.en: **Systemic risk.** General-purpose models of especially high capability carry a further layer of obligations and have to assess and mitigate systemic risks.
