goals.zh: 能解读修补结果，包括信息在哪一层从一个位置移到另一个位置，以及各个头的作用
goals.en: Read patching results, including at which layer information moves from one position to another and what each head does

goals.zh: 能说明归因修补的近似在哪里可靠、在哪里失效
goals.en: State where the approximation of attribution patching is reliable and where it fails

explain.zh: **基本做法。** 准备一条干净输入和一条损坏输入，两者只在一处不同，并且这一处的不同会使模型给出不同的答案。先在干净输入上运行一次，保存所有内部激活。再在损坏输入上运行，运行过程中把某一个激活（例如第 6 层之后某个位置的残差流）替换成干净运行中保存的值，其余部分照常计算。如果输出因此从损坏输入的答案变回了干净输入的答案，说明被替换的这个激活携带了决定答案的信息。度量通常取 9.2 中的 logit 差，并归一化到 0 与 1 之间，0 表示与损坏运行相同，1 表示完全恢复到干净运行的水平。推导 1 给出了定义。
explain.en: **The basic procedure.** A clean input and a corrupted input are prepared that differ in one place, where the difference makes the model give different answers. The model is first run on the clean input and all internal activations are stored. It is then run on the corrupted input, and during the run one activation (for instance the residual stream at some position after layer 6) is replaced by the value stored from the clean run, while everything else is computed as usual. If the output thereby returns from the answer of the corrupted input to that of the clean input, the replaced activation carried the information that decides the answer. The metric is usually the logit difference of 9.2, normalized to lie between 0 and 1, where 0 means the same as the corrupted run and 1 means fully restored to the level of the clean run. Derivation 1 gives the definition.

explain.zh: **任务。** 本模块使用 Wang 等人研究过的间接宾语识别任务。句子 When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to 的下一个词应当是 Mary，即两个名字中没有重复出现的那一个。把第二个 John 换成 Mary，答案就变成 John。练习使用 8 对这样的句子，名字各不相同，每个句子 14 个 token，每对只在第 9 个位置（重复出现的名字，记作 S2）上不同。GPT-2 small 在干净输入上的平均 logit 差（正确名字减另一个名字）为 $+2.85$，在损坏输入上为 $-2.54$。损坏输入本身也是一个合理的句子，模型在两次运行中都在做同一类任务，这是修补优于置零的地方。
explain.en: **The task.** This module uses the indirect object identification task studied by Wang et al. The next word of the sentence When Mary and John went to the store, John gave a drink to should be Mary, the one of the two names that is not repeated. Replacing the second John by Mary turns the answer into John. The exercises use 8 such pairs with different names, 14 tokens per sentence, each pair differing only at position 9 (the repeated name, called S2). GPT-2 small has a mean logit difference (correct name minus the other name) of $+2.85$ on the clean inputs and $-2.54$ on the corrupted ones. The corrupted input is itself a reasonable sentence and the model performs the same kind of task in both runs, which is where patching is superior to zeroing.

explain.zh: **修补残差流，信息在哪里。** 练习 1 对每一层、每个位置的残差流各做一次修补。S2 之前的位置在两次运行中完全相同，修补它们没有任何效果。在第 0 至第 6 层之后，几乎全部效应都在 S2 位置上，数值从 1.00 缓慢降到 0.90。第 7 层之后，S2 位置降到 0.66，最后一个位置升到 0.38。第 8 层之后，S2 位置只剩 0.05，最后一个位置达到 0.93。图的左半部分画出了这一过程。可以读出，关于“哪个名字重复了”的信息在前 7 层停留在 S2 位置，在第 7 层和第 8 层被移到了最后一个位置。跨位置移动信息只有注意力能做到，这把下一步的搜索范围缩小到了第 7、8 层附近的注意力头。
explain.en: **Patching the residual stream, where the information is.** Exercise 1 patches the residual stream once for every layer and position. Positions before S2 are identical in the two runs and patching them has no effect. After layers 0 to 6 nearly the whole effect sits at position S2, falling slowly from 1.00 to 0.90. After layer 7 position S2 drops to 0.66 and the last position rises to 0.38. After layer 8 position S2 retains only 0.05 and the last position reaches 0.93. The left half of the figure shows this course. It can be read off that the information about which name was repeated stays at position S2 for the first 7 layers and is moved to the last position in layers 7 and 8. Moving information across positions is something attention alone can do, which narrows the next search to the attention heads around layers 7 and 8.

explain.zh: **修补注意力头，谁在起作用。** 练习 2 对 144 个头逐个修补，并区分只在最后一个位置修补和只在 S2 位置修补两种情况。结果列在下面的表中。效应的绝对值超过 0.05 的头有 17 个，其余一百多个头对这个任务几乎没有影响。效应最大的几个头分为两组。第 3 层第 0 个头、第 5 层第 5 个头和第 6 层第 9 个头只在 S2 位置起作用，按 Wang 等人的分类，它们是重复 token 头和归纳头，功能是识别出这个名字前面已经出现过。第 7 层的第 3、第 9 个头和第 8 层的第 6、第 10 个头只在最后一个位置起作用，它们被称为 S 抑制头，把“这个名字重复了”的信息搬到最后一个位置。第 9 层第 9 个头属于名字移动头，它读取没有被抑制的那个名字并把它写向输出。第 10 层第 7 个头和第 11 层第 10 个头的效应为负，论文称之为负向名字移动头，它们在压低正确答案。Wang 等人描述的完整回路包含 7 类共 26 个头，这里用 8 对句子和最简单的修补方式，效应最强的 8 个头全部落在他们列出的头当中。
explain.en: **Patching attention heads, who is acting.** Exercise 2 patches the 144 heads one by one and separates patching at the last position only from patching at position S2 only. The results are listed in the table below. Seventeen heads have an effect above 0.05 in absolute value, and the remaining hundred and more have almost no influence on this task. The heads with the largest effect fall into two groups. Head 0 of layer 3, head 5 of layer 5 and head 9 of layer 6 act at position S2 only. In the classification of Wang et al. they are duplicate token heads and induction heads, whose function is to recognize that this name has occurred before. Heads 3 and 9 of layer 7 and heads 6 and 10 of layer 8 act at the last position only. They are called S-inhibition heads and carry the information that this name was repeated to the last position. Head 9 of layer 9 is a name mover head, which reads the name that was not inhibited and writes it toward the output. Head 7 of layer 10 and head 10 of layer 11 have a negative effect. The paper calls them negative name mover heads, and they push the correct answer down. The full circuit described by Wang et al. comprises 26 heads in 7 classes. With 8 sentence pairs and the simplest form of patching, the 8 heads with the strongest effect here all belong to the heads they list.

explain.zh: **效应不能相加。** 144 个头的效应加起来是 1.74，不是 1。原因是这些头前后相接。修补上游的重复 token 头，下游的 S 抑制头和名字移动头会随之得到正确的输入，于是整条通路都恢复了。修补下游的头，同一条通路又被计算了一次。修补测到的是一个组件的总效应，包括它经由后面各组件产生的间接作用，这正是 9.2 的直接归因所缺少的部分，代价是各组件的数值不再构成一个分摊。表中第 9 层第 6 个头的效应为 $-0.05$，而论文把它列为名字移动头。论文使用了更大的数据集和不同的修补方式，这里的样本很小，这个差别不宜过度解读。
explain.en: **Effects do not add up.** The effects of the 144 heads sum to 1.74 and not to 1. The reason is that these heads are connected in series. When an upstream duplicate token head is patched, the S-inhibition heads and name mover heads downstream receive correct inputs and the whole pathway is restored. When a downstream head is patched, the same pathway is counted once more. Patching measures the total effect of a component, including what it does indirectly through later components, which is the part that the direct attribution of 9.2 lacks, at the price that the numbers of the components no longer form a split. Head 6 of layer 9 has an effect of $-0.05$ in the table, while the paper lists it as a name mover head. The paper used a larger dataset and a different way of patching and the sample here is small, so the difference should not be over-interpreted.

explain.zh: **两个方向。** 本模块把干净运行的激活换入损坏运行，问的是这个激活是否足以恢复正确的行为。也可以反过来，把损坏运行的激活换入干净运行，问的是这个激活是否为正确的行为所必需。Heimersheim 和 Nanda 的指南把前者称为去噪，后者称为加噪，并强调两者回答的问题不同。当模型中有多条通路可以互相替代时，加噪往往看不到单个组件的作用，去噪则可以看到。损坏输入的构造方式同样影响结论。Zhang 和 Nanda 系统地比较了不同的损坏方式和度量，发现它们可以导致不同的定位结果。这里采用的是替换一个 token 的做法，两条输入的长度和结构保持一致，测到的只是“哪个名字重复”这一项信息的流向。模型怎样识别出句子中有两个名字、怎样知道下一个词应当是名字，在两次运行中完全相同，修补看不到这些计算。
explain.en: **Two directions.** This module moves activations of the clean run into the corrupted run, which asks whether an activation is sufficient to restore the correct behaviour. The reverse is also possible. Moving activations of the corrupted run into the clean run asks whether an activation is necessary for the correct behaviour. The guide by Heimersheim and Nanda calls the former denoising and the latter noising and stresses that the two answer different questions. When a model has several pathways that can stand in for one another, noising often fails to show the role of a single component where denoising does show it. How the corrupted input is built affects the conclusions as well. Zhang and Nanda compared different corruption methods and metrics systematically and found that they can lead to different localization results. The approach here replaces one token, keeping the length and structure of the two inputs the same, and what is measured is the flow of the single piece of information about which name is repeated. How the model recognizes that the sentence contains two names, and how it knows that the next word should be a name, is identical in the two runs, and patching does not see these computations.

explain.zh: **归因修补。** 逐个修补 144 个头需要 144 次前向计算，对更大的模型和更细的粒度，这个数量会增长到无法承受。归因修补用一阶泰勒展开来近似。在损坏运行上做一次前向和一次反向计算，得到度量对每个激活的梯度，再用干净激活与损坏激活之差乘以梯度，就得到了所有激活的修补效应的估计，推导 2 给出了公式。练习 3 实现了这一方法。对 144 个头，估计值与实际修补结果的相关系数为 0.992，效应最强的 8 个头全部一致，用时 1.2 秒，而实际修补用时 27 秒。对残差流，近似在靠前的层明显失效。第 0 层之后 S2 位置的实际效应是 1.00，估计值只有 0.22。Nanda 在提出这一方法的文章中已经指出，它适用于头的输出这类较小的激活，不适用于整个残差流和靠前的层，部分原因是 LayerNorm 使沿残差流方向的变化在梯度中消失。练习的结果与这一说法一致。归因修补适合用来快速筛选，筛出的候选仍应以实际修补确认。
explain.en: **Attribution patching.** Patching 144 heads one by one takes 144 forward passes, a number that grows beyond reach for larger models and finer granularity. Attribution patching approximates with a first-order Taylor expansion. One forward and one backward pass on the corrupted run give the gradient of the metric with respect to every activation, and the difference between clean and corrupted activation multiplied by the gradient gives an estimate of the patching effect of all activations at once, with the formula in derivation 2. Exercise 3 implements the method. For the 144 heads the correlation between the estimate and the real patching result is 0.992, all of the 8 strongest heads agree, and the time is 1.2 seconds against 27 seconds for real patching. For the residual stream the approximation clearly fails in the early layers. After layer 0 the real effect at position S2 is 1.00 and the estimate is only 0.22. In the post that introduced the method Nanda already notes that it suits small activations such as head outputs and does not suit whole residual streams and early layers, partly because LayerNorm makes changes along the direction of the residual stream vanish from the gradient. The results of the exercise agree with this. Attribution patching is suited to fast screening, and the candidates it yields should still be confirmed by real patching.

explain.zh: **TransformerLens。** 前三个练习直接使用 PyTorch 的钩子，目的是看清每一步在做什么。实际研究中更常用 TransformerLens，它给模型内部的各个量起了统一的名字，例如 `blocks.8.hook_resid_post` 和 `blocks.8.attn.hook_z`，并提供 `run_with_cache` 和 `run_with_hooks` 两个函数，分别用于保存激活和在运行中改写激活。在 GPT-2 small 上它提供 493 个可以挂钩子的位置。练习 4 用它重写了残差流修补，结果与原生钩子的实现在小数点后五位内一致。需要注意版本。4.0 版删除了原先的 `HookedTransformer.from_pretrained` 接口，改用 `TransformerBridge.boot_transformers`，默认保留 Hugging Face 的原始权重，因此输出与 Hugging Face 模型相同。网上大量教程写于此前，其中的加载方式需要按迁移说明调整。
explain.en: **TransformerLens.** The first three exercises use the hooks of PyTorch directly, so that every step is visible. Actual research more often uses TransformerLens, which gives the internal quantities of a model uniform names, such as `blocks.8.hook_resid_post` and `blocks.8.attn.hook_z`, and provides the two functions `run_with_cache` and `run_with_hooks` for storing activations and for rewriting them during a run. On GPT-2 small it offers 493 places where hooks can be attached. Exercise 4 rewrites residual stream patching with it, and the result agrees with the raw-hook implementation to five decimal places. The version has to be minded. Version 4.0 removed the former interface `HookedTransformer.from_pretrained` in favour of `TransformerBridge.boot_transformers`, which by default keeps the original Hugging Face weights, so that the outputs equal those of the Hugging Face model. Many tutorials on the web predate this, and their way of loading has to be adapted following the migration guide.

explain.zh: **结论的范围。** 本模块的全部结果来自一个句子模板、8 对句子和 GPT-2 small。它们与已发表的研究一致，这提供了一定的信心，但换一个模板或一组名字后各个头的数值会变化。修补只能定位两条输入之间的差异所涉及的计算。找到一组效应大的头，也还不等于理解了回路。Wang 等人为回路提出了三项检验标准，即忠实性（回路单独运行能否重现完整模型的表现）、完备性（回路之外是否还有起作用的组件）和最小性（回路中是否有多余的组件）。这些检验需要成组地消融和修补，超出了本模块的范围，原论文是进一步学习的合适材料。
explain.en: **The scope of the conclusions.** All results of this module come from one sentence template, 8 sentence pairs and GPT-2 small. They agree with published research, which lends some confidence, yet the numbers of the individual heads change with another template or another set of names. Patching locates only the computation involved in the difference between two inputs. Having found a set of heads with large effects is also not the same as having understood a circuit. Wang et al. proposed three criteria for testing a circuit, namely faithfulness (whether the circuit run alone reproduces the performance of the full model), completeness (whether components outside the circuit also act) and minimality (whether the circuit contains superfluous components). These tests require ablating and patching groups of components and lie beyond this module, and the original paper is suitable material for further study.

caption.zh: 练习 2 的结果。对每个头做修补后的归一化效应，8 对句子的平均值。最后一列是 Wang 等人（2022）对该头的分类。
caption.en: Results of exercise 2. The normalized effect of patching each head, averaged over 8 sentence pairs. The last column is the class Wang et al. (2022) assign to the head.

source.text: Heimersheim & Nanda, How to use and interpret activation patching, arXiv:2404.15255

note.zh: 度量是最后一个位置上两个候选答案的 logit 差。$x_c$ 表示干净输入，$x_d$ 表示损坏输入。
note.en: The metric is the logit difference of the two candidate answers at the last position. $x_c$ denotes the clean input and $x_d$ the corrupted one.

note.zh: 在 $x_d$ 上运行，把激活 $a$ 强制设为它在 $x_c$ 上的取值，$a$ 之后的所有计算照常进行。这对应因果推断中的一次干预。
note.en: The model is run on $x_d$ with the activation $a$ forced to the value it takes on $x_c$, and all computation after $a$ proceeds as usual. This corresponds to an intervention in causal inference.

note.zh: 归一化后的效应。$E = 0$ 表示修补没有改变输出，$E = 1$ 表示完全恢复。对多对输入，分子和分母各自先取平均。$E$ 可以为负，也可以超过 1。
note.en: The normalized effect. $E = 0$ means patching did not change the output and $E = 1$ means full restoration. For several input pairs numerator and denominator are averaged separately first. $E$ can be negative and can exceed 1.

steps.tex: E(\text{all positions of layer } \ell) = 1, \qquad \sum_{a} E(a) \ne 1 \ \text{in general}

note.zh: 修补一层的全部位置会把损坏运行完全变成干净运行。单个激活的效应之和一般不等于 1，因为上游激活的效应已经包含了它通过下游激活产生的作用，同一条通路会被重复计算。
note.en: Patching all positions of a layer turns the corrupted run into the clean run entirely. The effects of single activations do not in general sum to 1, because the effect of an upstream activation already includes what it does through downstream activations, and the same pathway is counted repeatedly.

title.en: The first-order approximation of attribution patching

source.text: Nanda, Attribution Patching: Activation Patching At Industrial Scale

note.zh: 把度量看作被修补激活的取值 $a'$ 的函数，其他一切固定。$M(a_d) = m(x_d)$ 是不修补时的值，其中 $a_d = a(x_d)$。
note.en: The metric is regarded as a function of the value $a'$ given to the patched activation, with everything else fixed. $M(a_d) = m(x_d)$ is the value without patching, where $a_d = a(x_d)$.

note.zh: 在 $a_d$ 处做一阶泰勒展开。$a_c = a(x_c)$ 是干净运行中的取值。
note.en: A first-order Taylor expansion at $a_d$. $a_c = a(x_c)$ is the value in the clean run.

note.zh: 右边的梯度就是在损坏输入上对度量做一次反向传播时，激活 $a$ 处得到的梯度。一次反向传播同时给出所有激活的梯度，所以一次干净前向、一次损坏前向和一次反向就能估计所有修补的效应。
note.en: The gradient on the right is the gradient obtained at the activation $a$ in one backward pass of the metric on the corrupted input. One backward pass gives the gradients of all activations together, so one clean forward pass, one corrupted forward pass and one backward pass suffice to estimate the effects of all patches.

note.zh: 误差由二阶及更高阶的项决定，$H$ 是 $M$ 的 Hessian 矩阵。$a_c - a_d$ 较小时，或 $M$ 在这两点之间接近线性时，近似较好。单个头的输出满足前一个条件。整个残差流在靠前各层的差异很大，并且要经过许多非线性的层，近似因此失效。
note.en: The error is governed by the terms of second and higher order, with $H$ the Hessian of $M$. The approximation is good when $a_c - a_d$ is small or when $M$ is nearly linear between the two points. The output of a single head meets the first condition. The whole residual stream differs greatly in the early layers and passes through many nonlinear layers, and the approximation fails there.

q.zh: 激活修补与消融有什么区别？
q.en: How does activation patching differ from ablation?

a.zh: 消融把一个组件的输出换成零或平均值，问的是没有这个组件时模型表现怎样。修补把输出换成同一个组件在另一条精心选择的输入上的取值，问的是这个组件所携带的某一项特定信息有什么作用。修补的两个好处是，被换入的值是模型实际会产生的，后面的层不会收到异常的输入，并且通过选择两条输入的差别，可以只考察一项信息而保持其他一切不变。修补的局限也来自这里，它看不到两条输入共有的计算。
a.en: Ablation replaces the output of a component by zero or by a mean and asks how the model performs without the component. Patching replaces the output by the value the same component takes on another carefully chosen input and asks what one specific piece of information carried by the component does. The two advantages of patching are that the value moved in is one the model actually produces, so later layers receive no abnormal input, and that choosing the difference between the two inputs allows one piece of information to be examined with everything else held fixed. The limitation of patching has the same origin. It does not see the computation the two inputs share.

q.zh: 各个头的修补效应加起来为什么不等于 1？
q.en: Why do the patching effects of the heads not add up to 1?

a.zh: 因为修补测量的是总效应，而各个头并不独立。上游的头被修补后，下游的头会因为得到了正确的输入而一并恢复，所以上游头的效应里已经包含了下游头的贡献。把所有头的效应相加，同一条通路被计算了多次。本模块中 144 个头的效应之和为 1.74。如果需要一个可以相加的分解，应使用 9.2 的直接归因，或者使用只修补特定通路的路径修补，后者是 Wang 等人采用的方法。
a.en: Because patching measures total effects and the heads are not independent. When an upstream head is patched, downstream heads recover along with it since they receive correct inputs, so the effect of the upstream head already contains the contribution of the downstream ones. Adding the effects of all heads counts the same pathway several times. The effects of the 144 heads sum to 1.74 in this module. Where an additive decomposition is needed, the direct attribution of 9.2 or path patching, which patches specific pathways only and is the method used by Wang et al., is appropriate.

q.zh: 损坏输入应当怎样构造？
q.en: How should the corrupted input be constructed?

a.zh: 原则是只改变想要研究的那一项信息，其余尽量保持不变。常用的做法是替换一个或几个 token，使句子的长度和结构不变而答案改变。早期的研究（例如 Meng 等人定位事实知识的工作）采用向主语的嵌入加高斯噪声的做法，Zhang 和 Nanda 的比较表明不同的损坏方式可以给出不同的定位结果。损坏输入决定了测到的是什么。如果它与干净输入的差别不止一处，修补效应就混合了几项信息的作用，结果会难以解释。
a.en: The principle is to change only the one piece of information under study and to keep the rest as unchanged as possible. A common approach replaces one or a few tokens so that the length and structure of the sentence stay the same while the answer changes. Earlier work (for example the study by Meng et al. locating factual knowledge) added Gaussian noise to the embeddings of the subject, and the comparison by Zhang and Nanda shows that different corruption methods can give different localization results. The corrupted input determines what is measured. If it differs from the clean input in more than one respect, the patching effect mixes the roles of several pieces of information and becomes hard to interpret.

q.zh: 归因修补的结果可以直接使用吗？
q.en: Can the results of attribution patching be used directly?

a.zh: 适合用于筛选，不适合作为最终证据。它是线性近似，在激活差异较小且度量接近线性的地方准确，例如单个头的输出，本模块中相关系数达到 0.992。在整个残差流、靠前的层以及非线性较强的地方，它可以严重偏离，本模块中第 0 层的估计只有实际值的五分之一左右。稳妥的流程是先用归因修补对所有组件排序，再对排在前面的组件做实际修补。
a.en: They suit screening and do not suit as final evidence. The method is a linear approximation that is accurate where the difference in activation is small and the metric nearly linear, as for the output of a single head, where the correlation reaches 0.992 in this module. For whole residual streams, early layers and places with strong nonlinearity it can deviate badly, the estimate at layer 0 being only about a fifth of the real value in this module. A sound procedure ranks all components by attribution patching and then patches the top-ranked ones for real.

q.zh: 什么是回路，怎样才算验证了一个回路？
q.en: What is a circuit, and what counts as having verified one?

a.zh: 回路指模型中共同完成某项功能的一组组件以及它们之间的连接。找到几个修补效应大的头只是起点。Wang 等人对间接宾语识别回路提出了三项标准，即忠实性、完备性和最小性，分别检验回路能否重现模型的表现、是否遗漏了起作用的组件、是否包含多余的组件。他们还发现模型中存在备用的头，主要的头被去掉后会接替其功能，这使得“哪些头属于回路”这个问题本身没有唯一的答案。回路分析给出的是对一个特定任务、特定输入分布的描述，换一个分布未必成立。
a.en: A circuit is a set of components of a model that jointly perform some function, together with the connections among them. Finding a few heads with large patching effects is a starting point only. For the indirect object identification circuit Wang et al. proposed three criteria, faithfulness, completeness and minimality, testing respectively whether the circuit reproduces the performance of the model, whether acting components were left out and whether superfluous components are included. They also found backup heads in the model that take over when the main heads are removed, so that the question of which heads belong to the circuit has no unique answer. A circuit analysis describes one specific task on one specific input distribution and need not hold on another.

caption.zh: 间接宾语识别任务上的激活修补，GPT-2 small，8 对句子的平均值，由练习 1 和练习 2 的参考实现算出。左，把干净运行的残差流换入损坏运行后恢复的比例。右，对 144 个头逐个修补的效应。
caption.en: Activation patching on the indirect object identification task, GPT-2 small, mean over 8 sentence pairs, computed with the reference solutions of exercises 1 and 2. Left, the share restored when the residual stream of the clean run is moved into the corrupted run. Right, the effect of patching each of the 144 heads.

plain.zh: 像排查两台电脑的故障。一台正常，一台有问题，两台只有一处配置不同。把正常那台的零件一个一个换到故障机上，换到哪个零件时故障消失，问题就与那个零件有关。激活修补做的就是这件事，零件是模型内部某一层某个位置上的数值，两台电脑是两次只差一个词的运行。
plain.en: It is like troubleshooting two computers. One works, one has a fault, and the two differ in one setting. Parts of the working machine are swapped into the faulty one, one at a time, and the part whose swap makes the fault disappear is involved in the problem. Activation patching does exactly this. The parts are the values at some position in some layer inside the model, and the two computers are two runs that differ in one word.

summary.zh: 训练一个线性分类器去读取中间表示中的信息，用对照实验判断结果是否可信，再沿找到的方向改写表示，检验模型是否使用了它。
summary.en: Training a linear classifier to read information from intermediate representations, judging by control experiments whether the result can be trusted, and rewriting the representation along the direction found to test whether the model uses it.

why.zh: logit lens 只能读出以输出词表的形式存在的信息。许多值得研究的性质并不是下一个 token，例如一个地名位于哪个大洲、一句话是真是假、当前上下文中是否出现了工具结果。探针为这类性质提供了读取的办法，做法是在模型的中间表示上另外训练一个小分类器。它实现简单，也因此是可解释性方法中最容易得出错误结论的一种。分类器本身有学习能力，维度很高时几乎任何标签都能在训练集上拟合。本模块用一个地理方面的例子完成一次完整的探针实验，重点放在对照实验上，随后介绍引导向量，它把探针从读取变成改写，从而可以回答模型是否使用了探针找到的信息。
why.en: The logit lens reads only information present in the form of the output vocabulary. Many properties worth studying are not a next token, such as the continent a place lies in, whether a statement is true, or whether a tool result is present in the current context. Probes offer a way of reading such properties, by training a small separate classifier on the intermediate representations of the model. They are simple to implement and for that reason the interpretability method from which wrong conclusions are drawn most easily. The classifier has learning capacity of its own, and in high dimensions almost any labels can be fitted on the training set. This module carries out a complete probing experiment on a geographic example with the emphasis on the controls, and then introduces steering vectors, which turn the probe from reading into rewriting and thereby answer whether the model uses the information the probe found.

goals.zh: 能在冻结模型的中间表示上训练线性探针，并用留出数据评估
goals.en: Train a linear probe on the intermediate representations of a frozen model and evaluate it on held-out data

goals.zh: 能设计并解读对照实验，说明探针准确率中有多少来自表示本身
goals.en: Design and read control experiments that show how much of the probe accuracy comes from the representation itself

goals.zh: 能用均值差构造引导向量，并检验它对输出的因果作用
goals.en: Build a steering vector from a difference of means and test its causal effect on the output

explain.zh: **探针是什么。** 探针是在冻结的模型上另外训练的分类器，输入是某一层的激活，输出是研究者关心的某个标签。模型本身不参与训练。Alain 和 Bengio 最早系统地使用了线性探针，用它衡量各层表示的线性可分程度。如果一个很简单的分类器就能从某一层的表示中读出某个性质，就说这个性质在该层是线性可读的。探针限制为线性，是为了让读出的能力尽量来自表示，而不是来自分类器自身。
explain.en: **What a probe is.** A probe is a classifier trained separately on a frozen model, with the activations of some layer as input and a label of interest to the researcher as output. The model itself takes no part in the training. Alain and Bengio were the first to use linear probes systematically, measuring with them how linearly separable the representations of each layer are. If a very simple classifier can read a property from the representation of a layer, the property is said to be linearly readable at that layer. Probes are restricted to linear ones so that the ability to read comes as far as possible from the representation and not from the classifier.

explain.zh: **实验设置。** 练习 1 研究 GPT-2 small 的表示中是否包含城市所在的大洲。数据是 160 个城市，欧洲、亚洲、非洲和美洲各 40 个。每个城市构成一条输入 The city of X，取最后一个 token 上嵌入之后和 12 个块各自之后的状态，共 13 组 768 维的向量。探针是带 L2 正则的多类逻辑回归，输入先做标准化。评估采用分层 5 折交叉验证，每一折用 128 个城市训练，在另外 32 个城市上测试，探针因此必须对没有见过的城市作出判断。160 个样本的规模很小，准确率在 0.85 附近时标准误约为 0.03，不同折划分下第 9 层的结果在 0.81 到 0.86 之间。正则强度 $C$ 取 0.1，在 0.01 到 10 的范围内改变它，第 9 层的准确率在 0.81 到 0.83 之间，结论不依赖于这个取值。
explain.en: **The setup.** Exercise 1 studies whether the representations of GPT-2 small contain the continent of a city. The data are 160 cities, 40 each from Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas. Every city forms an input The city of X, and the states at the last token after the embedding and after each of the 12 blocks are taken, 13 sets of vectors of 768 dimensions. The probe is multinomial logistic regression with L2 regularization on standardized inputs. Evaluation uses stratified 5-fold cross-validation, training on 128 cities and testing on the other 32 in every fold, so that the probe has to judge cities it has not seen. A sample of 160 is small. At an accuracy around 0.85 the standard error is about 0.03, and the result at layer 9 ranges from 0.81 to 0.86 over different fold assignments. The regularization strength $C$ is set to 0.1. Varying it from 0.01 to 10 gives an accuracy at layer 9 between 0.81 and 0.83, so the conclusion does not depend on this value.

explain.zh: **结果。** 留出城市上的准确率在嵌入之后是 0.72，随层数缓慢上升，第 10 层之后达到 0.86，随机猜测的水平是 0.25。图的左半部分画出了这条曲线。有两点值得注意。信息在嵌入层就已经有了大部分，说明它主要来自城市名这个 token 本身的嵌入，各层的计算只把它从 0.72 提高到 0.86。相邻两层之间的差别大多在一个标准误以内，在这个样本量下不能据此断言信息是在哪一层形成的。
explain.en: **Results.** The accuracy on held-out cities is 0.72 after the embedding and rises slowly with depth to 0.86 after layer 10, against a chance level of 0.25. The left half of the figure shows this curve. Two points deserve attention. Most of the information is present at the embedding already, which shows that it comes mainly from the embedding of the city name token itself, with the computation of the layers raising it only from 0.72 to 0.86. The differences between adjacent layers are mostly within one standard error, and at this sample size they do not allow a statement about the layer at which the information is formed.

explain.zh: **三个对照。** 准确率 0.86 本身说明不了多少，需要与对照比较。第一个对照把标签随机打乱。在留出城市上，各层的准确率在 0.15 到 0.25 之间，与随机猜测相当。同样的探针在训练集上对打乱的标签却能达到 1.00，因为 768 维空间中的 160 个点几乎可以按任何方式线性分开，推导 2 说明了原因。训练集上的准确率因此没有参考价值，这是探针实验必须使用留出数据的原因。第二个对照把模型换成权重随机初始化的 GPT-2。它的各层准确率在 0.33 到 0.41 之间，高于 0.25。一个没有训练过的模型不可能知道地理，这部分准确率来自输入的表面特征。四个大洲的城市名被切分成的 token 数不同，非洲城市平均 2.60 个，欧洲城市平均 1.25 个，位置编码把 token 数带进了表示，仅凭 token 数训练的探针就有 0.41 的准确率。第三个对照是嵌入层本身，上面已经提到。合理的说法是，探针的 0.86 应当与 0.41 这个基线比较，而不是与 0.25 比较。Hewitt 和 Liang 提出的对照任务把这种比较规范化了。他们给每个词分配一个随机标签，要求探针在真实任务上准确率高而在对照任务上准确率低，两者之差称为选择性。
explain.en: **Three controls.** An accuracy of 0.86 says little by itself and has to be compared with controls. The first control shuffles the labels at random. On held-out cities the accuracy of the layers lies between 0.15 and 0.25, at the level of chance. The same probe nonetheless reaches 1.00 on the training set with shuffled labels, because 160 points in a space of 768 dimensions can be separated linearly in almost any way, as derivation 2 explains. Accuracy on the training set is therefore uninformative, which is why probing experiments have to use held-out data. The second control replaces the model by a GPT-2 with randomly initialized weights. Its accuracy lies between 0.33 and 0.41 across the layers, above 0.25. A model that was not trained cannot know geography, so this part of the accuracy comes from surface features of the input. The city names of the four continents are split into different numbers of tokens, 2.60 on average for African cities and 1.25 for European ones, the positional encoding carries the token count into the representation, and a probe trained on the token count alone reaches an accuracy of 0.41. The third control is the embedding layer itself, mentioned above. A fair statement is that the 0.86 of the probe should be compared with the baseline of 0.41 and not with 0.25. The control tasks of Hewitt and Liang formalize this comparison. They assign every word a random label and require a probe to be accurate on the real task and inaccurate on the control task, the difference between the two being called selectivity.

explain.zh: **读得出来不等于被使用。** 探针回答的是信息是否存在于表示中，没有回答模型是否用它来产生输出。练习 1 的最后一项观察说明了两者的差别。让模型自己续写 The city of X is in，并只比较 Europe、Asia、Africa 和 America 四个词的 logit，模型答对的比例是 0.65，其中欧洲城市为 1.00，美洲城市为 0.42。探针从同一个模型的表示中读出的准确率是 0.86。这个比较并不完全对等，美洲的城市更可能被续写为国家名或 North America，但它说明表示中线性可读的信息可以多于模型在输出中表现出来的。Belinkov 对探针方法的综述讨论了这类局限。探针的结果刻画的是表示与标签之间的相关性。
explain.en: **Readable is not the same as used.** A probe answers whether information is present in a representation and not whether the model uses it to produce output. The last observation of exercise 1 shows the difference. When the model itself continues The city of X is in and only the logits of the four words Europe, Asia, Africa and America are compared, the model is right in a share of 0.65, with 1.00 for European cities and 0.42 for American ones. The probe reads the same information from the representations of the same model with an accuracy of 0.86. The comparison is not fully like for like, since cities of the Americas are more likely continued with the name of a country or with North America, yet it shows that the information linearly readable from a representation can exceed what the model displays in its output. The survey of probing methods by Belinkov discusses limitations of this kind. A probing result characterizes a correlation between representation and label.

explain.zh: **从读取到改写。** 检验模型是否使用某个方向，办法是沿这个方向改变表示，再看输出是否随之改变。练习 2 用最简单的方式构造方向，即取 20 个亚洲城市在某一层的平均状态，减去 20 个欧洲城市的平均状态。这个向量称为引导向量。然后对另外 20 个没有参与计算的欧洲城市，在城市名最后一个 token 的位置上把引导向量的 $\alpha$ 倍加到该层的输出上，观察模型续写时 Asia 与 Europe 的 logit 差。不做干预时这个差值平均为 $-2.90$。在第 6 层加上 2 倍的引导向量后，差值变为 $+2.24$，20 个城市全部转为倾向 Asia。作为对照，加上一个长度相同、方向随机的向量，差值仍为 $-2.26$，没有一个城市发生转变。图的右半部分给出了各层的结果。这说明效果来自方向，而不是来自对表示施加了一个大的扰动，也说明模型后面的计算确实读取了这个方向。
explain.en: **From reading to rewriting.** Whether the model uses a direction is tested by changing the representation along the direction and seeing whether the output changes with it. Exercise 2 builds a direction in the simplest way, as the mean state of 20 Asian cities at some layer minus the mean state of 20 European cities. This vector is called a steering vector. For another 20 European cities that took no part in the computation, $\alpha$ times the steering vector is then added to the output of the layer at the position of the last token of the city name, and the logit difference between Asia and Europe in the continuation of the model is observed. Without intervention this difference is $-2.90$ on average. With twice the steering vector added at layer 6 it becomes $+2.24$, and all 20 cities turn toward Asia. As a control, adding a vector of the same length in a random direction leaves the difference at $-2.26$, and not a single city turns. The right half of the figure gives the results for the layers. This shows that the effect comes from the direction and not from applying a large perturbation to the representation, and that the later computation of the model does read this direction.

explain.zh: **强度与层。** $\alpha = 1$ 相当于把欧洲城市的平均状态移到亚洲城市的平均状态上，此时只有 50% 到 70% 的城市发生转变，因为各个城市分布在均值的周围。$\alpha = 2$ 时转变的比例在第 0 至第 8 层为 90% 到 100%。在第 10 层做同样的干预则几乎无效，$\alpha = 2$ 时没有城市转变。到这一层，决定答案的信息已经被注意力从城市名的位置搬到了最后一个位置，再改写城市名位置上的表示为时已晚。这与 9.3 中信息在中间层由一个位置移到另一个位置的图景一致。引导向量在哪一层、哪个位置有效，本身就提供了关于信息流向的证据。
explain.en: **Strength and layer.** $\alpha = 1$ amounts to moving the mean state of the European cities onto the mean state of the Asian ones, and only 50% to 70% of the cities turn then, because the individual cities are spread around the mean. With $\alpha = 2$ the share that turns is 90% to 100% in layers 0 to 8. The same intervention at layer 10 has almost no effect, with no city turning at $\alpha = 2$. By that layer the information that decides the answer has been carried by attention from the position of the city name to the last position, and rewriting the representation at the position of the city name comes too late. This agrees with the picture of 9.3, in which information moves from one position to another in the middle layers. At which layer and position a steering vector works is itself evidence about the flow of information.

explain.zh: **探针方向与均值差方向。** 逻辑回归探针的权重向量也是一个方向，它与均值差方向并不相同。在第 6 层，欧洲对亚洲的二分类探针的权重向量与均值差的余弦相似度是 0.84。把它缩放到相同的长度后用于引导，$\alpha = 2$ 时 95% 的城市发生转变，与均值差方向的效果相近。Marks 和 Tegmark 在研究真假陈述的表示时报告，均值差方向比其他探针方法找到的方向与模型输出的因果联系更强。在这里的小样本上没有看到明显的差别，这不足以支持或反对他们的结论。两种方向不同的原因在于目标不同，探针寻找的是最能区分两类的方向，会利用任何有区分度的特征，均值差描述的则是两类的中心相差多少。
explain.en: **The probe direction and the direction of the mean difference.** The weight vector of a logistic regression probe is a direction as well and is not the same as the mean difference. At layer 6 the weight vector of the binary probe for Europe against Asia has a cosine similarity of 0.84 with the mean difference. Scaled to the same length and used for steering, it turns 95% of the cities at $\alpha = 2$, close to the effect of the mean difference. In their study of the representation of true and false statements Marks and Tegmark report that directions from the mean difference are more causally implicated in the output of the model than those found by other probing methods. No clear difference shows on the small sample here, which is not enough to support or contradict their conclusion. The two directions differ because their aims differ. A probe seeks the direction that best separates two classes and will exploit any discriminating feature, whereas the mean difference describes how far apart the centres of the two classes are.

explain.zh: **文献中的相关结果。** Gurnee 和 Tegmark 在 Llama-2 系列模型上用线性探针研究了地点和时间的表示，报告模型在多个尺度上学到了空间和时间的线性表示，并且这种表示在不同的提示写法和不同类型的实体之间保持稳定。Turner 等人把加入引导向量的做法称为激活加法，用一对对比的提示（例如 Love 与 Hate）在中间层的激活之差作为引导向量，不需要任何优化就能在推理时改变输出的情感和话题。这些工作使用的模型远大于 GPT-2 small，本模块的小实验在方法上与它们相同，在规模和结论的强度上不能相比。
explain.en: **Related results in the literature.** Gurnee and Tegmark studied the representation of places and times in the Llama-2 family with linear probes and report that the models learn linear representations of space and time at several scales, which remain stable across different prompt wordings and different types of entities. Turner et al. call the adding of steering vectors activation addition. They take the difference between the intermediate activations of a pair of contrasting prompts (such as Love and Hate) as the steering vector and change the sentiment and topic of the output at inference time without any optimization. These studies use models far larger than GPT-2 small. The small experiments of this module share their method and cannot be compared with them in scale or in the strength of the conclusions.

explain.zh: **局限。** 本模块的引导实验只检查了一对大洲、一个提示模板和一个输出指标。加入引导向量之后模型的其他行为是否受损，这里没有测量，而这在实际使用中是必须检查的。线性探针读不出以非线性方式编码的信息，探针准确率低因此不能说明信息不存在。均值差方向依赖于用来计算它的两组样本，样本中任何系统性的差别都会进入方向，例如上面看到的 token 数。城市的选择也带有偏向，这里的 160 个城市都是较为知名的大城市，结论不能推广到不常见的地名。
explain.en: **Limitations.** The steering experiment of this module examines one pair of continents, one prompt template and one output metric. Whether other behaviour of the model is damaged after the steering vector is added is not measured here, and in practical use this has to be checked. Linear probes cannot read information encoded nonlinearly, so a low probe accuracy does not show that information is absent. The mean difference depends on the two sets of samples used to compute it, and any systematic difference between the samples enters the direction, such as the token count seen above. The choice of cities is biased too. The 160 cities here are all fairly well-known large cities, and the conclusions do not extend to less common place names.

title.zh: 逻辑回归探针及其梯度
title.en: The logistic regression probe and its gradient

source.text: Alain & Bengio, Understanding intermediate layers using linear classifier probes, arXiv:1610.01644

note.zh: $h$ 是某一层的激活，$W$ 的每一行对应一个类别。这与模型输出层的形式相同，只是 $W$ 是另外训练的，类别是研究者定义的标签。
note.en: $h$ is the activation of some layer and every row of $W$ belongs to one class. The form is that of the output layer of the model, except that $W$ is trained separately and the classes are labels defined by the researcher.

steps.tex: \mathcal{L}(W, b) = -\frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \log p(y_i \mid h_i) + \frac{1}{2 C n} \lVert W \rVert_F^2

note.zh: 交叉熵加上 L2 正则项。$C$ 越小正则越强。模型的参数不在优化变量之中，$h_i$ 是固定的数据。
note.en: Cross-entropy plus an L2 penalty. A smaller $C$ means stronger regularization. The parameters of the model are not among the optimization variables, and the $h_i$ are fixed data.

note.zh: $p_i$ 是第 $i$ 个样本的预测分布，$e_{y_i}$ 是真实类别的 one-hot 向量。这是 1.3 中 softmax 与交叉熵的梯度公式的直接应用。
note.en: $p_i$ is the predicted distribution of sample $i$ and $e_{y_i}$ the one-hot vector of the true class. This applies the gradient formula for softmax and cross-entropy of 1.3 directly.

note.zh: 损失是凸的，加上正则项后有唯一的最优解。因此探针的结果不依赖于初始化和优化过程，这是选用逻辑回归而不选用小型神经网络的一个实际理由。
note.en: The loss is convex and has a unique optimum with the penalty added. The result of the probe therefore does not depend on initialization or on the course of optimization, a practical reason for choosing logistic regression over a small neural network.

title.zh: 高维空间中任意标签都可以线性分开
title.en: In high dimensions any labels can be separated linearly

source.text: Hewitt & Liang, Designing and Interpreting Probes with Control Tasks, arXiv:1909.03368

note.zh: 把 $n$ 个样本的激活排成矩阵的行。当样本数不超过维数，并且各样本线性无关时，$X$ 的秩为 $n$。随机取的点几乎总是满足这一条件。
note.en: The activations of $n$ samples form the rows of a matrix. When the number of samples does not exceed the dimension and the samples are linearly independent, $X$ has rank $n$. Points drawn at random satisfy this condition almost surely.

note.zh: $X$ 行满秩，所以对任意的目标向量 $t$，线性方程组 $X w = t$ 都有解，例如 $w = X^\top (X X^\top)^{-1} t$。
note.en: $X$ has full row rank, so the linear system $X w = t$ has a solution for every target vector $t$, for example $w = X^\top (X X^\top)^{-1} t$.

note.zh: 这个 $w$ 把每个样本都分到了指定的一侧。$t$ 是任意的，所以无论标签怎样分配，包括完全随机的分配，都存在一个线性分类器在这 $n$ 个样本上全部正确。
note.en: This $w$ puts every sample on the prescribed side. Since $t$ is arbitrary, for any assignment of labels, a completely random one included, there is a linear classifier that is right on all $n$ samples.

steps.tex: n = 128,\ d = 768 \ \Longrightarrow\ \text{training accuracy} = 1 \text{ for any labels}

note.zh: 练习 1 中每一折用 128 个城市训练，激活有 768 维，符合上述条件。训练准确率为 1 因此不包含关于表示的任何信息。能区分真实标签与随机标签的，只有在没有见过的样本上的准确率。
note.en: Every fold of exercise 1 trains on 128 cities with activations of 768 dimensions, which meets the condition above. A training accuracy of 1 therefore carries no information about the representation. What distinguishes real labels from random ones is the accuracy on unseen samples alone.

q.zh: 探针的准确率很高，是否说明模型“知道”这个性质？
q.en: Does a high probe accuracy show that the model knows the property?

a.zh: 这个推断需要三个条件才比较稳妥。准确率是在留出数据上测得的。它明显高于对照，包括随机标签、随机权重的模型和输入的表面特征。并且有干预实验表明模型的输出依赖于探针找到的方向。只满足第一条时，高准确率可能来自分类器的拟合能力。只满足前两条时，可以说信息存在于表示中，还不能说模型使用了它。本模块的例子中三条都做了检验，结论是 GPT-2 small 的表示中有可以线性读出的大洲信息，其中相当一部分来自词嵌入，并且在所检验的那个提示下，模型的输出确实依赖于这个方向。
a.en: The inference is fairly safe under three conditions. The accuracy is measured on held-out data. It is clearly above the controls, including random labels, a model with random weights and surface features of the input. And an intervention shows that the output of the model depends on the direction the probe found. With the first condition alone, a high accuracy may come from the fitting capacity of the classifier. With the first two, the information can be said to be present in the representation and cannot yet be said to be used by the model. All three were tested in the example of this module, with the conclusion that the representations of GPT-2 small contain linearly readable information about the continent, a considerable part of it from the word embeddings, and that under the one prompt tested the output of the model does depend on this direction.

q.zh: 为什么用线性探针，而不用更强的分类器？
q.en: Why a linear probe and not a stronger classifier?

a.zh: 分类器越强，越难区分读出的能力来自表示还是来自分类器自身。一个足够大的多层网络可以从词嵌入出发自己学会许多性质，这时探针的准确率反映的是探针学到了什么。线性探针的限制使结论更接近于表示本身。它的代价是读不出非线性编码的信息。Hewitt 和 Liang 的做法是不预先限定探针的形式，而用选择性来衡量，即真实任务与对照任务的准确率之差。
a.en: The stronger the classifier, the harder it is to tell whether the ability to read comes from the representation or from the classifier. A sufficiently large multilayer network can learn many properties by itself starting from word embeddings, in which case the probe accuracy reflects what the probe learned. The restriction to linear probes keeps the conclusion closer to the representation. Its price is that information encoded nonlinearly cannot be read. The approach of Hewitt and Liang does not fix the form of the probe in advance and measures selectivity, the difference in accuracy between the real task and the control task.

q.zh: 探针和 logit lens 有什么区别？
q.en: How do probes differ from the logit lens?

a.zh: logit lens 使用模型自己的输出矩阵，不需要训练，只能读出以词表形式存在的信息，读出的内容与模型的实际输出直接相关。探针另外训练一个分类器，可以读取任意定义的性质，同时带来了分类器自身可能学到东西的问题，需要对照实验来约束。两者可以配合使用。先用 logit lens 观察候选答案在各层的名次，再用探针检验某个不直接对应 token 的中间变量是否存在。
a.en: The logit lens uses the output matrix of the model itself, requires no training and reads only information present in the form of the vocabulary, and what it reads relates directly to the actual output of the model. A probe trains a separate classifier and can read properties defined at will, which brings the problem that the classifier may learn things itself and has to be constrained by controls. The two can be used together. The logit lens shows the ranks of candidate answers across the layers, and a probe then tests whether some intermediate variable that does not correspond directly to a token is present.

q.zh: 引导向量与微调、提示词相比有什么特点？
q.en: What distinguishes steering vectors from fine-tuning and from prompting?

a.zh: 引导向量在推理时直接修改中间激活，不改变权重，也不占用上下文。构造它只需要几条对比样本上的前向计算。Turner 等人的论文摘要称这种方法不需要优化，用一对样本即可得到，并且可以保持模型在无关任务上的表现。它的不足是效果依赖于层、位置和强度的选择，强度过大时输出会变得不通顺，对复杂行为的控制能力也不如微调。在研究中它的主要价值是作为因果检验的工具，本模块就是这样使用它的。
a.en: A steering vector modifies intermediate activations directly at inference time, without changing weights and without taking up context. Building one takes only forward passes on a few contrasting examples. The abstract of the paper by Turner et al. states that the method needs no optimization, works with a single pair of data points and preserves performance on off-target tasks. Its weaknesses are that the effect depends on the choice of layer, position and strength, that the output becomes incoherent when the strength is too large, and that it controls complex behaviour less well than fine-tuning. In research its main value is as a tool for causal tests, which is how this module uses it.

q.zh: 随机初始化的模型为什么也能得到高于随机的准确率？
q.en: Why does a randomly initialized model also score above chance?

a.zh: 因为它的表示虽然不包含学到的知识，却仍然是输入的确定性函数，输入的表面特征会保留在其中。本模块中起作用的表面特征是城市名的 token 数，非洲城市的名字平均被切成 2.60 个 token，欧洲城市平均 1.25 个，位置编码使探针可以读出这一差别。这类混淆在探针实验中很常见，标签往往与词频、长度或拼写相关。随机权重的模型是检查这类混淆的一个方便的基线，更直接的办法是像练习中那样，单独用表面特征训练一个探针。
a.en: Because its representations, though they contain no learned knowledge, are still a deterministic function of the input and retain surface features of it. The surface feature at work in this module is the number of tokens of the city name. Names of African cities are split into 2.60 tokens on average and those of European cities into 1.25, and the positional encoding lets the probe read this difference. Confounds of this kind are common in probing experiments, where labels often correlate with word frequency, length or spelling. A model with random weights is a convenient baseline for checking them, and a more direct way is to train a probe on the surface feature alone, as the exercise does.

caption.zh: 左，预测城市所在大洲的线性探针在各层的留出准确率，以及两个对照。右，在城市名位置加入 2 倍均值差向量后，留出的欧洲城市中转为倾向 Asia 的比例。数据由练习 1 和练习 2 的参考实现在 GPT-2 small 上算出。
caption.en: Left, the held-out accuracy at every layer of a linear probe predicting the continent of a city, with two controls. Right, the share of held-out European cities that turn toward Asia after twice the mean-difference vector is added at the position of the city name. Computed with the reference solutions of exercises 1 and 2 on GPT-2 small.

plain.zh: 探针像给模型做脑电图。在某一层贴上电极，训练一个很简单的读数器，看能不能从信号里读出“这个城市在哪个大洲”。读得出来，说明信息在那里，却不说明大脑用到了它，也可能只是读数器自己太聪明，所以需要对照实验。引导向量是反过来的做法，在那个位置施加一个小小的刺激，看行为是否随之改变。
plain.en: A probe is like an EEG of the model. Electrodes are attached at some layer and a very simple reader is trained to see whether the signal reveals which continent a city is on. If it does, the information is there, which does not show that the brain uses it, and the reader may merely be too clever by itself, hence the need for controls. A steering vector goes the other way. A small stimulus is applied at that place to see whether the behaviour changes with it.

q.zh: 为什么同样的 prompt 会输出不同结果？temperature 设为 0 为什么有时仍不完全一样？
q.en: Why does the same prompt give different outputs, and why can temperature 0 still vary?

q.zh: 为什么模型会产生幻觉？
q.en: Why do models hallucinate?

q.zh: 为什么模型数不清单词里有几个字母、算不准大数？
q.en: Why can models not count letters in a word or do large arithmetic?

q.zh: 为什么长对话中模型会“忘记”前面的内容？
q.en: Why do models forget earlier parts of a long conversation?

q.zh: 为什么 few-shot 和 CoT 会提升效果？
q.en: Why do few-shot examples and chain-of-thought help?

q.zh: 为什么输出的 JSON 有时格式不对，怎么保证格式正确？
q.en: Why is output JSON sometimes malformed, and how can it be guaranteed?

q.zh: 为什么同一个问题换个说法结果差很多？
q.en: Why does rephrasing a question change the answer so much?

q.zh: 为什么输入越长越贵、越慢？
q.en: Why are longer inputs slower and more expensive?

q.zh: 为什么 Transformer 用 LayerNorm 而较少用 BatchNorm，为什么 Pre-Norm 成为主流？
q.en: Why LayerNorm and not BatchNorm, and why did Pre-Norm become standard?

q.zh: 为什么需要位置编码，RoPE 为什么被广泛采用？
q.en: Why are positional encodings needed, and why is RoPE so widely used?

q.zh: 为什么同样的内容，中文和英文的 token 数不同？
q.en: Why does the same content cost a different number of tokens in Chinese and English?

q.zh: 为什么输出 token 通常比输入 token 贵，为什么输出是逐 token 返回的？
q.en: Why do output tokens usually cost more than input tokens, and why is output streamed token by token?

q.zh: 为什么 LoRA 只训练很少的参数也有效？
q.en: Why does LoRA work with so few trainable parameters?

q.zh: 为什么微调后模型会遗忘原有能力？
q.en: Why does fine-tuning make a model forget what it could do?

q.zh: 为什么 RAG 检索到了正确文档，答案仍然可能出错？
q.en: Why can RAG answer wrongly even after retrieving the right document?

q.zh: 为什么 system prompt 会被绕过？
q.en: Why can a system prompt be bypassed?

q.zh: 为什么 LLM 评委会偏向某个位置或偏向自己的输出？
q.en: Why do LLM judges favour a position or their own outputs?

q.zh: 为什么模型不清楚当前日期和自己的知识截止时间？
q.en: Why does a model not know today's date or its own knowledge cutoff?

note.zh: 题库检索于 2026 年 11 月 25 日。题目均取自实际读到的网页，问法尽量保持原样，答案为本路线撰写并指向相应模块。“原始面经”指面试者本人发布的记录，“整理合集”指他人汇总或题目来源未逐条说明的材料。来源数是这次检索中见到同一问题的页面数，不代表真实的出题频率。国内的原始面经主要来自牛客，海外的第一手记录较少，多数海外题目来自整理合集，公司标签只在来源明确标注时填写。未检索到公司官方发布的技术题目，也未见到针对阶段 9 可解释性内容的面试题。
note.en: The bank was compiled on 25 November 2026. All questions are taken from web pages actually read, with the wording kept as close to the original as possible, and the answers were written for this roadmap and point to the matching modules. A first-hand report is a record posted by the interviewee, and a curated collection is material compiled by others or without item-by-item sourcing. The source count is the number of pages on which a question was seen in this search and does not represent how often it is really asked. First-hand reports from China come mainly from Nowcoder. First-hand records from abroad are scarcer, most international questions come from curated collections, and company labels are given only where the source states them. No technical questions published officially by companies were found, nor any interview questions on the interpretability content of stage 9.

def.zh: 模型处理文本的最小单位，可以是一个词、半个词、一个汉字或一个标点。
def.en: The smallest unit of text a model handles. It can be a word, part of a word, a character or a punctuation mark.

def.zh: 把文本切成 token 并换成编号的程序，也负责把编号还原成文本。
def.en: The program that cuts text into tokens and maps them to ids, and maps ids back to text.

def.zh: 模型认识的全部 token 的列表。GPT-2 的词表有 50257 项。
def.en: The list of all tokens a model knows. GPT-2 has 50257 entries.

def.zh: 把 token 编号变成向量的查找表，也指查出来的那个向量。
def.en: The lookup table that turns a token id into a vector, and also the vector itself.

def.zh: 带形状的多维数组。向量和矩阵是一维和二维的张量。
def.en: A multi-dimensional array with a shape. Vectors and matrices are 1-D and 2-D tensors.

def.zh: 某一层输出的每个位置的向量。
def.en: The vector at each position that a layer outputs.

def.zh: 从嵌入一直通到最后一层的那条向量通路，每一层都往上面加一点东西。可解释性研究中常用这个说法。
def.en: The vector pathway that runs from the embedding to the last layer, with every layer adding something to it. A common term in interpretability.

def.zh: 模型给词表中每个 token 打的原始分数，经过 softmax 后变成概率。
def.en: The raw scores a model gives every token in the vocabulary. Softmax turns them into probabilities.

def.zh: 把一组任意实数变成一组和为 1 的正数的函数。
def.en: The function that turns any set of real numbers into positive numbers that sum to 1.

def.zh: 每次生成一个 token，并把它作为下一次的输入。
def.en: Generating one token at a time and feeding it back as input for the next.

def.zh: 根据模型给出的概率决定输出哪个 token 的过程。
def.en: The process of deciding which token to output from the probabilities the model gives.

def.zh: 每一步都选概率最大的 token。
def.en: Taking the most probable token at every step.

def.zh: 每一步按概率随机抽取一个 token。
def.en: Drawing a token at random according to the probabilities at every step.

def.zh: 采样前用来缩放 logits 的数。越低输出越确定，越高越随机。
def.en: The number that scales the logits before sampling. Lower means more deterministic, higher more random.

def.zh: 两种先去掉低概率候选再采样的做法。top-k 保留概率最高的 k 个，top-p 保留累计概率达到 p 的最小集合。
def.en: Two ways to drop low-probability candidates before sampling. Top-k keeps the k most probable, top-p keeps the smallest set whose cumulative probability reaches p.

def.zh: 同时保留若干条候选序列，每一步扩展并留下总概率最高的几条。
def.en: Keeping several candidate sequences at once, extending them at each step and retaining those with the highest total probability.

def.zh: 模型一次能读入的 token 数量上限。
def.en: The maximum number of tokens a model can read at once.

def.zh: 交给模型的输入文本。
def.en: The input text given to a model.

def.zh: 放在对话最前面、用来设定模型角色和规则的一段文字。
def.en: Text placed at the start of a conversation that sets the role and rules for the model.

def.zh: 模型中通过训练学到的数。
def.en: The numbers in a model that are learned through training.

def.zh: 训练前由人设定的量，如层数、学习率。
def.en: A quantity set by people before training, such as the number of layers or the learning rate.

def.zh: 保存了某一时刻全部参数的文件。
def.en: A file that stores all parameters at one moment.

def.zh: 从输入算到输出的过程。
def.en: Computing the output from the input.

def.zh: 从损失出发，算出每个参数的梯度的过程。
def.en: Computing the gradient of every parameter, starting from the loss.

def.zh: 损失对参数的导数，指示参数往哪个方向调整会让损失变小。
def.en: The derivative of the loss with respect to a parameter. It shows which direction of change lowers the loss.

def.zh: 衡量模型预测与正确答案差距的一个数，训练的目标是让它变小。
def.en: A number that measures the gap between prediction and truth. Training aims to reduce it.

def.zh: 语言模型使用的损失，等于正确 token 的概率取对数再取负。
def.en: The loss used by language models, the negative log of the probability of the correct token.

def.zh: 交叉熵取指数，可理解为模型平均在多少个候选之间犹豫。
def.en: The exponential of cross-entropy, readable as the number of candidates the model hesitates between on average.

def.zh: batch 是一次送进模型的一组样本。step 是一次参数更新。epoch 是把整个训练集过一遍。
def.en: A batch is a group of samples fed in at once. A step is one parameter update. An epoch is one pass over the whole training set.

def.zh: 让每个位置按相关程度从其他位置收集信息的机制。
def.en: The mechanism by which each position gathers information from other positions according to relevance.

def.zh: 一层里并行的若干组注意力，每组称为一个头。
def.en: A layer runs several attention computations in parallel. Each is called a head.

def.zh: Transformer 的重复单元，内部是一次注意力加一个 MLP。
def.en: The repeated unit of a Transformer, with one attention and one MLP inside.

def.zh: 每层中对各个位置独立做变换的小型全连接网络。两个名字指同一个东西。
def.en: The small fully connected network in each layer that transforms every position independently. Both names mean the same thing.

def.zh: 把一个向量调整到均值为 0、方差为 1 再缩放的操作，用来稳定训练。
def.en: An operation that shifts a vector to zero mean and unit variance and then rescales it, used to stabilize training.

def.zh: 在海量文本上训练模型预测下一个 token。
def.en: Training a model to predict the next token on vast amounts of text.

def.zh: 在预训练模型的基础上，用较少的专门数据继续训练。
def.en: Continuing to train a pretrained model on a smaller, specialized dataset.

def.zh: 用训练好的模型计算输出。此时参数不变。
def.en: Using a trained model to compute outputs. The parameters do not change.

def.zh: 生成时把已经算过的中间结果存起来，避免每个新 token 都重算整段输入。
def.en: Storing intermediate results during generation so that each new token does not recompute the whole input.

def.zh: 在 Jupyter 和 Colab 中指后台执行代码的进程。在卷积网络中指卷积核。在 GPU 编程中指在 GPU 上运行的一段函数。
def.en: In Jupyter and Colab, the background process that runs code. In convolutional networks, the convolution filter. In GPU programming, a function that runs on the GPU.

def.zh: GPU 是擅长并行矩阵运算的处理器。CUDA 是 NVIDIA 提供的让程序使用 GPU 的软件接口。
def.en: A GPU is a processor suited to parallel matrix arithmetic. CUDA is NVIDIA's software interface for programs to use the GPU.

def.zh: 存储一个数用的位数。位数越少越省显存，精度也越低。
def.en: The number of bits used to store one number. Fewer bits save memory and lower the precision.

def.zh: 模型的权重文件可以公开下载。它不等同于训练数据和训练代码也公开。
def.en: The weight files of a model can be downloaded publicly. This does not imply that training data and training code are public too.

def.zh: 先检索相关资料，再把资料和问题一起交给模型生成回答。
def.en: Retrieving relevant material first and giving it to the model together with the question.

def.zh: 让模型在循环中自己决定调用什么工具、何时结束的系统。
def.en: A system in which the model decides in a loop which tools to call and when to stop.

def.zh: 模型生成了流畅但与事实或给定资料不符的内容。
def.en: Fluent output that does not match the facts or the given material.

def.zh: 用来比较模型的一套固定题目和评分方法。
def.en: A fixed set of tasks and a scoring method used to compare models.

def.zh: 网络中间某处算出来的数值。可解释性研究主要分析这些数值。
def.en: A value computed somewhere inside the network. Interpretability work mainly analyses these values.

def.zh: 记录每个结果由哪些值经过什么运算得到的图。反向传播沿着它倒着走。
def.en: A record of which values and operations produced each result. Backpropagation walks it backwards.

def.zh: 只有一个位置是 1、其余都是 0 的向量，用来表示“正确答案是第几个”。
def.en: A vector with a single 1 and 0 elsewhere, used to say which entry is the correct answer.

def.zh: 多个输出对多个输入的全部偏导数排成的矩阵。
def.en: The matrix of all partial derivatives of several outputs with respect to several inputs.

def.zh: 函数的输入落在输出几乎不再变化的区域，此时梯度接近 0。
def.en: The input of a function lies where the output barely changes, so the gradient is near 0.

def.zh: 两个向量对应分量相乘再求和。方向越一致，结果越大。
def.en: The sum of the products of matching components of two vectors. The more aligned they are, the larger the result.

def.zh: 衡量一组数偏离平均值程度的量。标准差是它的平方根。
def.en: A measure of how far a set of numbers spreads from its mean. The standard deviation is its square root.

def.zh: 注意力中的三种向量。query 表示当前位置在找什么，key 表示每个位置能提供什么，value 是被取走的内容。
def.en: The three kinds of vectors in attention. The query says what the current position looks for, the key what each position offers, and the value is the content taken.

def.zh: query、key、value 都来自同一段序列的注意力。
def.en: Attention in which queries, keys and values all come from the same sequence.

def.zh: query 来自一段序列、key 和 value 来自另一段序列的注意力。
def.en: Attention in which the queries come from one sequence and the keys and values from another.

def.zh: 禁止每个位置读取它之后内容的下三角掩码。
def.en: The lower-triangular mask that forbids each position from reading what comes after it.

def.zh: 只使用带因果掩码的层的架构，如 GPT。
def.en: An architecture that uses only layers with a causal mask, such as GPT.

def.zh: 不加因果掩码、每个位置能看到全文的架构，如 BERT。
def.en: An architecture without a causal mask in which every position sees the whole text, such as BERT.

def.zh: 一个 encoder 读入输入、一个 decoder 生成输出的架构，如 T5。
def.en: An architecture with an encoder that reads the input and a decoder that generates the output, such as T5.

def.zh: 遮住一部分 token，让模型根据两侧上下文填回的训练方式。
def.en: A training method that hides some tokens and has the model fill them back in from context on both sides.

def.zh: 告诉模型每个 token 排在第几个的信息。可以加在嵌入上，也可以在注意力内部引入。
def.en: Information that tells the model where each token sits. It can be added to the embeddings or introduced inside attention.

def.zh: 把输入的顺序打乱，输出只是跟着换顺序，数值不变。
def.en: Shuffling the input merely shuffles the output the same way, with the values unchanged.

def.zh: 旋转位置编码。按位置把 query 和 key 旋转一个角度，使注意力分数只依赖相对位置。
def.en: Rotary position embedding. Queries and keys are rotated by an angle set by their position, so the attention score depends only on relative position.

def.zh: 把子层的输出加到它的输入上，即 x + F(x)。
def.en: Adding the output of a sublayer to its input, x + F(x).

def.zh: LayerNorm 的简化版，不减均值，只按均方根缩放。
def.en: A simplified LayerNorm that skips the mean subtraction and scales by the root mean square only.

def.zh: 归一化放在子层入口称为 Pre-Norm，放在残差相加之后称为 Post-Norm。
def.en: Normalization at the entrance of a sublayer is Pre-Norm. Normalization after the residual addition is Post-Norm.

def.zh: 两种平滑的非线性函数，可以看作没有硬折线的 ReLU。SiLU 也叫 Swish。
def.en: Two smooth nonlinear functions, readable as ReLU without the hard kink. SiLU is also called Swish.

def.zh: 带门控支路的 FFN，用一个经过 SiLU 的向量逐元素地调节另一个向量。
def.en: An FFN with a gating branch, where a vector passed through SiLU modulates another element by element.

def.zh: 计算量随输入规模增长的方式。O(T²) 表示输入变成两倍时计算量约变成四倍。
def.en: How computation grows with input size. O(T²) means doubling the input roughly quadruples the computation.

def.zh: 浮点运算次数，用来衡量计算量。
def.en: The number of floating-point operations, a measure of computation.

def.zh: 介于字符和单词之间的文本片段。常见词是一个子词，罕见词由几个子词拼成。
def.en: A piece of text between a character and a word. Common words are one subword and rare words are built from several.

def.zh: 字节对编码。反复把出现最多的相邻一对合并成新 token，以此构造词表。
def.en: Byte-pair encoding. The vocabulary is built by repeatedly merging the most frequent adjacent pair into a new token.

def.zh: 以字节而不是字符作为最小单位。任何文本都能表示，初始词表固定为 256。
def.en: Using bytes and not characters as the smallest unit. Any text can be represented and the initial vocabulary is fixed at 256.

def.zh: 在子词合并之前，先按规则把文本切成小段的步骤。
def.en: The step that cuts text into small segments by rule before subword merging.

def.zh: 一个直接在原始文本上训练的分词工具，把空格当作普通符号 ▁ 处理。
def.en: A tokenization tool that trains directly on raw text and treats the space as the ordinary symbol ▁.

def.zh: 把字符存成字节的常用编码。英文字母占 1 个字节，常用汉字占 3 个字节。
def.en: The common encoding that stores characters as bytes. An English letter takes 1 byte and a common Chinese character 3 bytes.

def.zh: 相关信息位于长输入的中间时，模型利用它的效果比位于开头或结尾时差。
def.en: When relevant information sits in the middle of a long input, the model uses it less well than at the beginning or end.

def.zh: 输入的 token 数增加时，模型的准确率和召回逐渐下降的现象。
def.en: The gradual decline of accuracy and recall as the number of input tokens grows.

def.zh: 对话超出窗口时的两种处理方式。截断是丢弃较早的内容，压缩是把它们概括成摘要。
def.en: Two ways of handling a conversation that exceeds the window. Truncation drops earlier content and compaction summarizes it.

def.zh: 标签由数据自身提供的训练方式，不需要人工标注。预测下一个 token 就是一例。
def.en: Training in which the data supply their own labels, with no human annotation. Predicting the next token is one example.

def.zh: 训练时每一步都以真实的前文作为输入，而不是模型自己生成的内容。
def.en: Feeding the real preceding text as input at every training step and not the model's own output.

def.zh: 根据梯度决定每个参数具体怎样更新的算法，如 SGD、AdamW。
def.en: The algorithm that decides how each parameter is updated from its gradient, such as SGD or AdamW.

def.zh: 控制每一步参数更新幅度的数。
def.en: The number that controls the size of each parameter update.

def.zh: 每一步把参数向 0 拉回一点的正则化手段。
def.en: A regularizer that pulls the parameters a little towards 0 at every step.

def.zh: 监督微调。用带有期望输出的样本继续训练模型，指令微调是其中最常见的一种。
def.en: Supervised fine-tuning. Continuing to train a model on examples with desired outputs. Instruction tuning is its most common form.

def.zh: 把多条带角色的消息拼成模型输入文本的固定格式。
def.en: The fixed format that assembles several messages with roles into the input text of a model.

def.zh: 专门加进词表、用来表示结构而不是内容的 token，如消息的开始和结束标记。
def.en: A token added to the vocabulary to mark structure and not content, such as the start and end markers of a message.

def.zh: 在新数据上训练后，模型在原有任务上的表现明显下降。
def.en: A clear drop in performance on earlier tasks after training on new data.

def.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习。先从人的偏好中学出奖励模型，再用它的分数训练语言模型。
def.en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback. A reward model is learned from human preferences and its scores train the language model.

def.zh: 给一个回答打分的模型，分数表示人对它的偏好程度。
def.en: A model that scores a response, where the score expresses how much people prefer it.

def.zh: 强化学习中做决策的模型。在 RLHF 里就是正在训练的语言模型。
def.en: The decision-making model in reinforcement learning. In RLHF it is the language model being trained.

def.zh: 衡量两个概率分布差别的量。两个分布相同时为 0，否则为正。
def.en: A measure of the difference between two probability distributions. It is 0 when they are equal and positive otherwise.

def.zh: 通过提高高回报行为的概率来训练策略的方法。
def.en: Training a policy by raising the probability of actions with high return.

def.zh: 近端策略优化。一种限制每次更新幅度的策略梯度算法。
def.en: Proximal policy optimization. A policy-gradient algorithm that limits the size of each update.

def.zh: 模型倾向于说用户想听的话，而不是准确的内容。
def.en: The tendency of a model to tell users what they want to hear and not what is accurate.

def.zh: 直接偏好优化。不训练奖励模型，直接用偏好数据上的一个分类损失来对齐模型。
def.en: Direct preference optimization. Aligns a model directly with a classification loss on preference data, without training a reward model.

def.zh: 描述两两比较的概率模型。一方胜出的概率是双方分数之差的 sigmoid。
def.en: A probabilistic model of pairwise comparisons. The probability that one side wins is the sigmoid of the difference of the two scores.

def.zh: 低秩适配。冻结原有权重，只训练加在旁边的两个小矩阵的乘积。
def.en: Low-rank adaptation. The original weights are frozen and only the product of two small matrices added beside them is trained.

def.zh: 一个矩阵可以写成两个小得多的矩阵的乘积，即它只包含少数几个独立的方向。
def.en: A matrix that can be written as a product of two much smaller matrices, that is, one containing only a few independent directions.

def.zh: 参数高效微调。只训练少量参数的各种微调方法的统称，也是 Hugging Face 一个库的名字。
def.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The umbrella term for fine-tuning methods that train few parameters, and also the name of a Hugging Face library.

def.zh: 描述损失怎样随模型大小、数据量和算力变化的经验规律。
def.en: An empirical regularity describing how the loss changes with model size, data and compute.

def.zh: 形如 y = c·x^p 的关系，在双对数坐标下是一条直线。
def.en: A relation of the form y = c·x^p, a straight line in log-log coordinates.

def.zh: 一种能力在较小的模型中不存在，在较大的模型中存在。
def.en: An ability that is absent in smaller models and present in larger ones.

def.zh: 随机数序列的起点。固定它之后，同一环境下的采样结果可以重复。
def.en: The starting point of a random number sequence. With it fixed, sampled results repeat in the same environment.

def.zh: 计算机用有限位数表示小数带来的舍入误差。它使运算结果与运算顺序有关。
def.en: The rounding error of representing real numbers with finitely many bits. It makes results depend on the order of operations.

def.zh: 推理的两个阶段。prefill 并行处理整个提示词，decode 逐个生成输出 token。
def.en: The two phases of inference. Prefill processes the whole prompt in parallel and decode generates output tokens one by one.

def.zh: 从发出请求到收到第一个输出 token 的时间。
def.en: The time from sending a request to receiving the first output token.

def.zh: 单位时间内生成的 token 数，常以每秒 token 数表示。
def.en: The number of tokens generated per unit of time, usually given as tokens per second.

def.zh: 每生成一个 token 就立即发送给用户，而不是等全部生成完毕。
def.en: Sending every token to the user as soon as it is generated instead of waiting for the whole output.

def.zh: 服务商保留一段提示词前缀的计算结果，供后续以相同前缀开头的请求复用。
def.en: A provider keeps the computed results of a prompt prefix for reuse by later requests starting with the same prefix.

def.zh: 要求模型的输出符合给定的数据格式，例如某个 JSON Schema。
def.en: Requiring the output of a model to follow a given data format, such as a JSON Schema.

def.zh: 描述 JSON 数据结构的标准写法，规定有哪些字段以及各自的类型。
def.en: The standard notation for describing the structure of JSON data, specifying the fields and their types.

def.zh: 生成的每一步只允许选择不违反给定格式的 token。
def.en: Allowing, at every step of generation, only tokens that do not violate a given format.

def.zh: 由有限个状态和状态之间的转移规则组成的模型。读入一个字符就按规则转移到下一个状态。
def.en: A model made of finitely many states and transition rules between them. Reading a character moves it to the next state by rule.

def.zh: 把不允许的 token 的 logit 设为负无穷，使其概率为 0。
def.en: Setting the logits of disallowed tokens to minus infinity, which gives them probability 0.

def.zh: 一种比有限状态机表达能力更强的规则系统，可以描述任意深度的嵌套结构。
def.en: A rule system more expressive than a finite-state machine, able to describe nesting of arbitrary depth.

def.zh: 应用程序接口。这里指通过网络向服务商的模型发送请求并取回结果的方式。
def.en: Application programming interface. Here the way of sending requests to a provider's model over the network and receiving results.

def.zh: 模型在 Hugging Face Hub 上的说明页，开头的元数据记录许可证、基础模型等信息。
def.en: The documentation page of a model on the Hugging Face Hub, whose leading metadata record the license, base model and similar information.

def.zh: 用更少的位数表示每个权重，以减小模型占用的内存。
def.en: Representing every weight with fewer bits to reduce the memory a model takes.

def.zh: Mixture of Experts。每层有多组前馈网络，每个 token 只经过其中少数几组。
def.en: Mixture of experts. Every layer has several feed-forward networks and each token passes through only a few of them.

def.zh: 多个查询头共用一组键和值，以减少参数和 KV cache 的大小。
def.en: Several query heads share one set of keys and values, which reduces parameters and the size of the KV cache.

def.zh: llama.cpp 使用的模型文件格式，常用于分发量化后的模型。
def.en: The model file format of llama.cpp, commonly used to distribute quantized models.

def.zh: 规定他人可以怎样使用、修改和分发一件作品的法律文本。
def.en: The legal text that determines how others may use, modify and distribute a work.

def.zh: 对使用、修改和再分发限制很少的许可证，例如 Apache 2.0 和 MIT。
def.en: A license with few restrictions on use, modification and redistribution, such as Apache 2.0 and MIT.

def.zh: 只允许非商业用途的许可证，例如 CC BY-NC 4.0。
def.en: A license that allows only non-commercial use, such as CC BY-NC 4.0.

def.zh: 需要登录并同意条款、提交申请后才能下载的模型。
def.en: A model that can be downloaded only after logging in, agreeing to terms and submitting a request.

def.zh: 提示词中不给示例或只给少量示例。两种情况下模型的权重都不改变。
def.en: Giving no examples or a few examples in the prompt. The weights of the model change in neither case.

def.zh: 模型根据提示词中的示例完成新任务，不更新任何参数。
def.en: A model performing a new task from examples in the prompt without updating any parameter.

def.zh: 让模型在给出答案之前先写出中间的推理步骤。
def.en: Having a model write out intermediate reasoning steps before giving the answer.

def.zh: 对同一问题采样多条推理路径，取出现次数最多的答案。
def.en: Sampling several reasoning paths for the same question and taking the most frequent answer.

def.zh: 经典的关键词排序函数，综合考虑词的稀有程度、出现次数和段落长度。
def.en: The classic keyword ranking function, combining the rarity of a word, its frequency and the passage length.

def.zh: 把一段文本编码成一个向量的模型，含义相近的文本得到相近的向量。
def.en: A model that encodes a text as one vector, with texts close in meaning getting nearby vectors.

def.zh: 按向量之间的相似度查找最接近的段落。
def.en: Finding the closest passages by the similarity between vectors.

def.zh: Reciprocal Rank Fusion。只用名次把多个排序结果合并成一个。
def.en: Reciprocal rank fusion. Merging several rankings into one by ranks alone.

def.zh: 把问题和段落拼在一起输入并直接输出相关性分数的模型，常用于重排。
def.en: A model that takes question and passage together as input and outputs a relevance score directly, commonly used for reranking.

def.zh: 检索的两个评价指标。前者看正确段落是否进入前 k 名，后者是正确段落名次的倒数的平均值。
def.en: Two retrieval metrics. The first asks whether the correct passage is within the first k, the second averages the reciprocal of its rank.

def.zh: 模型输出一段结构化的文本，说明希望执行哪个函数以及参数是什么，由外围程序实际执行。也叫函数调用。
def.en: A model outputs structured text stating which function it wants executed and with which arguments, and the surrounding program performs the execution. Also called function calling.

def.zh: 通过输入或外部数据中的文本，使模型偏离开发者设定的指令。
def.en: Making a model deviate from the instructions set by its developer through text in the input or in external data.

def.zh: 让模型交替写出推理和动作的做法，推理用于规划，动作用于获取外部信息。
def.en: An approach in which the model writes reasoning and actions in alternation, the reasoning for planning and the actions for obtaining external information.

def.zh: 模型上下文协议。把 AI 应用连接到外部工具和数据源的开放标准。
def.en: Model Context Protocol. An open standard for connecting AI applications to external tools and data sources.

def.zh: 由预先写好的代码决定各个步骤的系统，与由模型自行决定下一步的智能体相对。
def.en: A system whose steps are determined by code written in advance, as opposed to an agent, in which the model decides the next step itself.

def.zh: 问答的两个基本指标。前者要求输出与参考答案归一化后完全相同，后者按共有的词计算精确率和召回率的调和平均。
def.en: Two basic metrics of question answering. The first requires the output to equal the reference after normalization, the second is the harmonic mean of precision and recall over shared words.

def.zh: 两类基于字面重合的指标，分别起源于机器翻译和摘要的评测。
def.en: Two families of metrics based on surface overlap, originating in the evaluation of machine translation and of summarization.

def.zh: 用一个语言模型给另一个模型的输出评分或比较优劣。
def.en: Using a language model to score or compare the outputs of another model.

def.zh: 评委的判断受到选项所在位置的影响，与内容无关。
def.en: The verdict of a judge being influenced by the position of an option, independent of its content.

def.zh: 扣除偶然一致之后两位标注者的一致程度。
def.en: The agreement between two annotators after subtracting agreement by chance.

def.zh: 对样本做有放回的重复抽样，用来估计统计量的不确定性。
def.en: Repeated resampling of a sample with replacement, used to estimate the uncertainty of a statistic.

def.zh: 判断一个前提是否蕴含、矛盾于或无关于一个假设的任务。
def.en: The task of deciding whether a premise entails, contradicts or is neutral to a hypothesis.

def.zh: 回答中的内容是否能在所给的资料中找到依据。
def.en: Whether the content of an answer is supported by the material supplied.

def.zh: Personally identifiable information。可以识别出具体个人的信息，例如姓名、电话、邮箱和账号。
def.en: Personally identifiable information. Information that identifies a specific person, such as a name, phone number, email address or account number.

def.zh: 这里指模型的输出随性别、族裔等属性发生的系统性差别。
def.en: Here, systematic differences in the output of a model depending on attributes such as gender or ethnicity.

def.zh: 欧盟第 2024/1689 号条例，按风险等级对人工智能系统和通用模型作出规定。
def.en: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, which regulates AI systems and general-purpose models by level of risk.

def.zh: 人工智能法中的两种身份。提供者开发系统或模型并以自己的名义投放市场，部署者在自己的权限下使用系统。
def.en: Two roles in the AI Act. A provider develops a system or model and places it on the market under its own name, and a deployer uses a system under its authority.

def.zh: 用于附件三所列领域或作为受监管产品安全部件的系统，须满足一系列严格的要求。
def.en: A system used in an area listed in Annex III or as a safety component of a regulated product, subject to a series of strict requirements.

def.zh: General-purpose AI model。能够胜任多种不同任务并可集成到各种下游系统中的模型。
def.en: General-purpose AI model. A model that can competently perform a wide range of distinct tasks and can be integrated into a variety of downstream systems.

def.zh: 中国的一项程序。具有舆论属性或社会动员能力的服务须向网信部门登记其算法的有关信息。
def.en: A procedure in China. Services with public opinion attributes or the capacity for social mobilization have to register information about their algorithms with the cyberspace authorities.

term.zh: 显式标识 / 隐式标识

def.zh: 中国对生成合成内容规定的两种标识。前者用户能够明显感知，后者写入文件元数据。
def.en: The two kinds of labels China prescribes for generated content. The first is clearly perceptible to users and the second is written into file metadata.

term.zh: NIST 人工智能风险管理框架

def.zh: 美国国家标准与技术研究院发布的自愿性框架，分为治理、映射、度量和管理四项功能。
def.en: A voluntary framework of the US National Institute of Standards and Technology, organized into the four functions govern, map, measure and manage.

def.zh: 美国总统对联邦行政部门发布的指令。它不是国会立法，会随政府更替而改变。
def.en: A directive of the US President to the federal executive branch. It is not an act of Congress and changes with administrations.

def.zh: 一个研究方向，目标是把神经网络内部的计算还原成人可以理解的算法，做法是分析具体的权重、激活和它们之间的因果关系。
def.en: A field of research that aims to reverse engineer the computation inside neural networks into algorithms people can understand, by analysing concrete weights, activations and the causal relations among them.

def.zh: 一个注意力头在一段输入上的全部权重，是一个 $T \times T$ 的矩阵，第 $i$ 行表示位置 $i$ 从各位置读取的比例。
def.en: All weights of one attention head on an input, a $T \times T$ matrix whose row $i$ gives the shares position $i$ reads from each position.

def.zh: 几乎把全部权重放在前一个位置上的注意力头，它把前一个 token 的信息写入当前位置。
def.en: An attention head that puts nearly all its weight on the previous position and writes information about the previous token into the current position.

def.zh: 完成“前文出现过 A B，再次遇到 A 时预测 B”的注意力头，读取上一次出现的同一 token 之后的位置。
def.en: An attention head that performs the step of predicting B on meeting A again after A B occurred earlier, reading the position after the previous occurrence of the same token.

term.zh: QK 回路 / OV 回路

def.zh: 对一个注意力头的两部分参数的称呼。$W_Q^\top W_K$ 决定从哪里读，$W_O W_V$ 决定读到的内容怎样写入残差流。
def.en: Names for the two parts of the parameters of an attention head. $W_Q^\top W_K$ decides where to read, and $W_O W_V$ decides how the content read is written into the residual stream.

def.zh: 去掉模型的一个组件（置零，或换成平均值或别的输入上的值），再观察输出的变化，用来检验该组件的作用。
def.en: Removing a component of the model (by zeroing it or replacing it by its mean or by its value on another input) and observing the change in the output, used to test the role of the component.

def.zh: PyTorch 的一种机制。在某个模块上注册一个函数，它会在该模块每次前向计算之前或之后被调用，可以读取或改写输入和输出。
def.en: A mechanism of PyTorch. A function registered on a module is called before or after every forward pass of the module and can read or rewrite its input and output.

def.zh: 把中间某一层之后的残差流经过最终的 LayerNorm 和输出矩阵，解码成词表上的 logits，用来观察预测怎样逐层形成。
def.en: Passing the residual stream after an intermediate layer through the final LayerNorm and the output matrix to decode it into logits over the vocabulary, used to observe how a prediction forms layer by layer.

def.zh: 把最后的残差流映射为词表上 logits 的矩阵，每一行对应一个 token。GPT-2 中它与输入嵌入共享权重。
def.en: The matrix that maps the last residual stream to logits over the vocabulary, with one row per token. In GPT-2 it shares weights with the input embedding.

def.zh: 把一个 logit 或 logit 差分解为各组件输出经最终 LayerNorm 和输出矩阵直接到达的贡献。不包含经由后续组件的间接作用。
def.en: Splitting a logit or a logit difference into the contributions that the outputs of the components make directly through the final LayerNorm and the output matrix. Indirect effects through later components are not included.

def.zh: 两个候选 token 的 logit 之差，等于它们概率之比的对数，是机制分析中最常用的度量。
def.en: The difference between the logits of two candidate tokens, equal to the logarithm of the ratio of their probabilities and the most common metric in mechanistic analysis.

def.zh: logit lens 的改进。为每一层训练一个仿射变换，先把该层的残差流变换到最后一层的坐标，再解码。
def.en: A refinement of the logit lens. An affine map is trained for every layer that first transforms the residual stream of the layer into the coordinates of the last layer before decoding.

def.zh: 把一次运行中的某个内部激活替换为另一次运行中的取值，观察输出的变化，用来测量该激活的因果作用。
def.en: Replacing an internal activation of one run by its value in another run and observing the change in the output, used to measure the causal effect of the activation.

term.zh: 干净运行 / 损坏运行

def.zh: 激活修补使用的两次运行。两条输入只在所研究的信息上不同，并导致不同的答案。
def.en: The two runs used in activation patching. The two inputs differ only in the information under study and lead to different answers.

def.zh: 模型中共同完成某项功能的一组组件以及它们之间的连接。
def.en: A set of components of a model that jointly perform some function, together with the connections among them.

def.zh: 机制可解释性中的一个标准任务。句中出现两个名字，其中一个重复，模型应当预测没有重复的那个。
def.en: A standard task in mechanistic interpretability. Two names occur in a sentence, one of them repeated, and the model should predict the one that is not repeated.

def.zh: 用梯度对激活修补做一阶近似，一次反向传播即可估计所有激活的修补效应。
def.en: A first-order approximation of activation patching by gradients, which estimates the patching effect of all activations with one backward pass.

def.zh: 机制可解释性研究常用的开源库，为模型内部的各个量提供统一的名字以及保存和改写激活的接口。
def.en: An open-source library widely used in mechanistic interpretability research, providing uniform names for the internal quantities of a model and an interface for storing and rewriting activations.

def.zh: 在冻结模型的某一层激活上另外训练的线性分类器，用来检验某个性质能否从该层的表示中读出。
def.en: A linear classifier trained separately on the activations of one layer of a frozen model, used to test whether a property can be read from the representation of that layer.

def.zh: 检验探针的一种办法。给输入分配随机标签，探针在真实任务上的准确率应当明显高于在对照任务上的准确率。
def.en: A way of testing probes. Inputs are assigned random labels, and the accuracy of a probe on the real task should be clearly above its accuracy on the control task.

def.zh: 指某个性质在激活空间中对应一个方向，沿该方向的投影大小反映该性质的取值。
def.en: The idea that a property corresponds to a direction in activation space, the projection onto which reflects the value of the property.

def.zh: 在推理时加到中间激活上的向量，用来使输出朝某个方向改变。通常由两组对比样本的激活之差得到。
def.en: A vector added to intermediate activations at inference time to shift the output in some direction. It is usually obtained from the difference between the activations of two contrasting sets of samples.

def.zh: 两组样本在某一层的平均激活之差，是构造引导向量和探针方向的最简单的办法。
def.en: The difference between the mean activations of two sets of samples at some layer, the simplest way of building steering vectors and probe directions.
